desc.zh: 红茶叶氧化后的干叶、树皮般香气
desc.en: Dry-leaf, bark-like aroma of oxidized black tea leaves

note.zh: 杭白菊、菊花茶：中国人更熟悉的同类花草茶香。
note.en: Chrysanthemum tea — the herbal-floral cup most Chinese drinkers know in place of chamomile.

note.zh: 芳樟醇是茉莉花茶的关键香气；极淡的吲哚给花香垫底。
note.en: Linalool is the key odorant of jasmine tea; a trace of indole gives the floral note its depth.

note.zh: β-紫罗兰酮是桂花的主要香气之一。
note.en: β-Ionone is one of the main aroma compounds of osmanthus.

note.zh: 乙酸芳樟酯与芳樟醇是佛手柑精油的主体；伯爵茶的香气也来自它。
note.en: Linalyl acetate and linalool dominate bergamot oil — the scent of Earl Grey.

note.zh: 深色多汁的桑葚，熟悉度更高的黑莓替身。
note.en: Dark, juicy mulberries — a more familiar stand-in for blackberry in China.

note.zh: 江南的杨梅：酸甜带树脂感的红色浆果。
note.en: Yangmei (Myrica rubra), a tart-sweet, slightly resinous red fruit from southern China.

note.zh: 黑醋栗（黑加仑）的特征硫香和“猫尿”味是同一类硫醇酯。
note.en: The catty, sulfury edge of blackcurrant comes from the same family of thiol esters.

note.zh: 新疆吐鲁番葡萄干的主要香气之一就是 β-大马士酮。
note.en: β-Damascenone is one of the main aroma compounds of Turpan (Xinjiang) raisins.

note.zh: 晒干的红枣：焦糖般的果干甜香。
note.en: Dried red dates: a caramel-like dried-fruit sweetness.

note.zh: 桂圆干（龙眼干）：烟熏般的深色果干甜香。
note.en: Dried longan: dark, smoky dried-fruit sweetness.

note.zh: 甲硫醇是榴莲的关键香气之一；在咖啡里极微量时反而是“新鲜感”的一部分。
note.en: Methanethiol is a key durian odorant; in coffee, a trace of it reads as freshness.

desc.zh: 即葡萄柚（不是柚子）

note.zh: 陈皮（晒干陈放的橘皮）：柑橘皮油加陈香，柠檬烯是主要成分。
note.en: Chenpi — sun-dried, aged mandarin peel; limonene is its main component.

desc.zh: 基本味觉之一（参照：柠檬酸溶液）
desc.en: A basic taste (reference: citric acid solution)

desc.zh: 闻起来“偏酸”的香气印象
desc.en: An aroma that smells “sour”

desc.zh: 醋：酸、涩、略冲
desc.en: Vinegar: sour, astringent, slightly pungent

note.zh: 乙酸也是区分中国四大名醋香气的关键物质之一。
note.en: Acetic acid is also one of the compounds that tell China’s four famous vinegars apart.

desc.zh: 帕玛森等陈年奶酪的酸败乳味
desc.en: Rancid-dairy note of aged cheeses such as Parmesan

desc.zh: 汗脚味，罗马诺奶酪
desc.en: Sweaty feet; Romano cheese

note.zh: 柠檬酸是咖啡液中唯一明显高于察觉阈值的有机酸（法压咖啡 0.23–0.60 g/L，阈值 <0.16 g/L），随烘焙加深而减少；但按平均浓度加进咖啡后，专业品鉴者也辨认不出（Rune 2023）。
note.en: Citric acid is the only organic acid clearly above its detection threshold in brewed coffee (0.23–0.60 g/L vs <0.16 g/L) and declines with roasting, yet experts could not identify it when spiked at average levels (Rune 2023).

note.zh: 苹果酸在咖啡液中约 0.12–0.20 g/L，与察觉阈值（0.20 g/L）相当或更低，单独难以尝出（Rune 2023）；杯测中的“苹果酸”感未必直接来自苹果酸本身。
note.en: Malic acid is present at about 0.12–0.20 g/L, at or below its 0.20 g/L detection threshold in coffee (Rune 2023), so a 'malic' impression in cupping need not come from malic acid itself.

desc.zh: 葡萄酒般尖锐、带果味的酒精感
desc.en: Sharp, fruity alcoholic note, like wine

desc.zh: 谷物发酵后蒸馏的烈酒
desc.en: Spirit distilled from fermented grain

note.zh: 中国的粮食蒸馏酒；不同香型的主体酯各不相同。
note.en: China’s grain spirit; each style has its own signature esters.

note.zh: 汾酒一类：乙酸乙酯是主体香（缺省实验证实）。
note.en: Fenjiu style: ethyl acetate carries the aroma (confirmed by omission tests).

note.zh: 五粮液、剑南春一类：果香酯浓郁。
note.en: Wuliangye style: rich in fruity esters.

desc.zh: 发酵水果或面团的酵母、酒精感
desc.en: Yeasty, alcoholic note of fermenting fruit or dough

note.zh: 糯米发酵的甜酒酿：甜、微酸、带酒香。
note.en: Fermented glutinous rice: sweet, slightly sour and boozy.

note.zh: 绍兴黄酒：苯乙醇是关键香气之一；甜型黄酒里葫芦巴内酯很重要。
note.en: Shaoxing wine: phenylethanol is a key odorant; sweet styles owe much to sotolon.

desc.zh: 熟过头的果蔬：甜、微酸、潮闷
desc.en: Fruit or vegetables past their best: sweet, slightly sour, damp

note.zh: 香蕉水是一种稀释剂，气味来自乙酸异戊酯。
note.en: A paint thinner whose smell comes from isoamyl acetate.

note.zh: 德式小麦啤酒的“丁香味”和咖啡里的是同一个分子。
note.en: The clove note of German wheat beer is the same molecule found in coffee.

desc.zh: 轻盈油脂感，可带黄油、青草、胡椒
desc.en: Light oiliness, sometimes buttery, grassy or peppery

desc.zh: 未经烹煮的食物，如生杏仁
desc.en: Uncooked food, such as raw almonds

note.zh: 生咖啡豆那股豆荚、生豆气主要来自异丁基甲氧基吡嗪。
note.en: The pod-like smell of unroasted coffee comes mostly from 2-isobutyl-3-methoxypyrazine.

desc.zh: 青涩未熟的水果
desc.en: Green, unripe fruit

desc.zh: 生豌豆：甜、豆味、清新
desc.en: Raw peas: sweet, beany, fresh

desc.zh: 新割青草与绿叶
desc.en: Freshly cut grass and green leaves

desc.zh: 煮过的菠菜、羽衣甘蓝、四季豆
desc.en: Cooked spinach, kale, green beans

desc.zh: 欧芹、菠菜等绿色蔬菜，略冲
desc.en: Green vegetables such as parsley and spinach; slightly pungent

desc.zh: 干草：微甜、干燥、带尘感
desc.en: Dry hay: slightly sweet, dry, dusty

desc.zh: 绿色香草：微甜、微辛、微苦
desc.en: Green herbs: slightly sweet, spicy and bitter

note.zh: 杭州径山茶的关键香气之一是二甲基硫醚，带海苔般的鲜甜。
note.en: Dimethyl sulfide, with its nori-like sweetness, is a key odorant of Jingshan tea from Hangzhou.

note.zh: 香椿芽的关键香气之一是三甲基吡嗪。
note.en: Trimethylpyrazine is one of the key odorants of toon shoots.

desc.zh: 煮熟的豆子及豆制品
desc.en: Cooked beans and bean products

desc.zh: 缺乏新鲜感，像放久的饼皮
desc.en: Lacking freshness, like an old pie crust

desc.zh: 纸箱、纸质包装
desc.en: Cardboard boxes, paper packaging

desc.zh: 白色纸杯、滤纸
desc.en: White paper cups, filter paper

desc.zh: 树皮：甜、褐色、微霉
desc.en: Tree bark: sweet, brown, slightly musty

desc.zh: 潮湿密闭的地下室
desc.en: A damp, closed-up basement

note.zh: 葡萄酒“木塞污染”的主要元凶是三氯苯甲醚。
note.en: Cork taint in wine is caused mainly by TCA.

desc.zh: 阁楼、衣柜等干燥密闭空间
desc.en: Dry, closed spaces such as attics and closets

desc.zh: 腐烂植物与潮湿黑土
desc.en: Decaying plants and damp black soil

note.zh: 自来水、池塘水的土霉味：国标对二甲基异莰醇限值 10 ng/L。
note.en: The musty taste of tap or pond water; China limits 2-MIB to 10 ng/L in drinking water.

desc.zh: 农场牲畜及其圈舍
desc.en: Farm animals and their barns

desc.zh: 煮肉、高汤
desc.en: Cooked meat, stock

note.zh: 酱色的红烧肉：浓郁、带甜的炖肉香。
note.en: Hongshao rou — soy-braised pork belly: rich, sweet, meaty.

desc.zh: 潮湿、霉、像皮革马具
desc.en: Damp, musty, like leather tack

desc.zh: 基本味觉之一（参照：咖啡因溶液）
desc.en: A basic taste (reference: caffeine solution)

note.zh: 咖啡的苦主要来自烘焙产物：浅中烘以绿原酸内酯为主（可解释去咖啡因咖啡约 80% 的苦味），深烘时 4-乙烯基儿茶酚低聚物带来更刺激的苦（Frank 2006、2007；Blumberg 2010）。咖啡因估计贡献 10–30%，且在咖啡中被黑色素削弱；葫芦巴碱只占约 1%，未列入（Gigl 2026）。
note.en: Coffee bitterness comes mainly from roasting products: chlorogenic acid lactones at light–medium roast (≈80% of the bitterness of decaf brew) and harsher 4-vinylcatechol oligomers at dark roast (Frank 2006, 2007; Blumberg 2010). Caffeine is estimated at 10–30% and is partly masked by melanoidins; trigonelline (≈1%) is not listed (Gigl 2026).

desc.zh: 基本味觉之一（参照：食盐溶液）
desc.en: A basic taste (reference: salt solution)

note.zh: 咖啡液含钾约 37–154 mg/100 mL，含钠一般不到 3 mg/100 mL（Olechno 2021）；钾的摩尔浓度与 WCR“咸”的最低参照相当，是最可能的来源，但没有找到人体感官研究证实咖啡中的咸味来自钾，证据薄弱。
note.en: Brews contain about 37–154 mg K/100 mL but usually <3 mg Na/100 mL (Olechno 2021); potassium is molar-comparable to the lowest WCR Salty reference and the most plausible source, but no sensory study confirming that coffee saltiness comes from it was found.

desc.zh: 创可贴、酒精、碘酒
desc.en: Adhesive bandages, rubbing alcohol, iodine

note.zh: 巴西咖啡的“Rio 味”：碘酒、药水般的缺陷，主因是三氯苯甲醚。
note.en: The Brazilian “Rio” defect — iodine-like and medicinal — caused mainly by TCA.

note.zh: 正露丸的木馏油气味主要来自愈创木酚。
note.en: The creosote smell of Seirogan pills is mostly guaiacol.

desc.zh: 原油及其制品，如凡士林
desc.en: Crude oil and its products, such as petroleum jelly

note.zh: WCR 词典“石油”的参照是凡士林和以对伞花烃配制的“柴油”标准品；对伞花烃在咖啡中有检出（Paiva 2025），葡萄酒“汽油味”的来源 TDN 也在胶囊咖啡中被初步鉴定（Lopes 2021），但两者都缺少咖啡中的定量和嗅闻数据。
note.en: The WCR references for Petroleum are petroleum jelly and a p-cymene-based 'diesel' standard; p-cymene has been detected in coffee (Paiva 2025) and TDN, the petrol note of Riesling, was putatively identified in capsule coffee (Lopes 2021), but neither has quantitative or olfactometry data in coffee.

desc.zh: 臭鼬般的气味
desc.en: A skunk-like smell

desc.zh: 橡皮筋：深沉、略尖锐
desc.en: Rubber bands: deep, slightly sharp

note.zh: 咖啡嗅闻研究中被描述为“橡胶味”的有 2,4-二甲基噻唑（Chin 2011）、5-乙基-2-甲基噻唑（López-Galilea 2006）和中深烘时的 2-丙基吡嗪（Obando 2024）；Batali 2022 引用的综述还把二乙基二硫醚、苯乙烯列为相关物质。罗布斯塔的“橡胶味”尚无单一分子解释：处理后橡胶、土味、焦味减弱的罗布斯塔，酚类和吡嗪类分别减少约 45% 和 37%（Moccand 2023）。
note.en: Coffee olfactometry has described 2,4-dimethylthiazole (Chin 2011), 5-ethyl-2-methylthiazole (López-Galilea 2006) and, in medium-to-dark roasts, 2-propylpyrazine (Obando 2024) as rubbery; a review cited by Batali 2022 adds diethyl disulfide and styrene. No single molecule explains the rubbery note of Robusta: a treatment that reduced rubbery, earthy and burnt notes cut phenolics by ~45% and pyrazines by ~37% (Moccand 2023).

note.zh: 握过铁栏杆、数过硬币后手上的“金属味”其实是 1-辛烯-3-酮。
note.en: The “metal” smell on your hands after holding coins is actually 1-octen-3-one.

note.zh: 早餐的油条外皮：典型的油炸香。
note.en: The crisp skin of breakfast fried dough sticks: the classic deep-fried smell.

desc.zh: 熟化烟叶：褐色、甜，带果香花香
desc.en: Cured tobacco leaf: brown and sweet, with fruity, floral notes

desc.zh: 熟化烟叶：褐色、微甜、略冲
desc.en: Cured tobacco leaf: brown, slightly sweet, slightly pungent

desc.zh: 过度烘烤的尖锐、苦、酸的焦味
desc.en: The sharp, bitter, sour burnt note of over-roasting

desc.zh: 燃烧后的残灰：干、尘、脏
desc.en: What is left after burning: dry, dusty, dirty

desc.zh: 木柴、树叶燃烧的烟
desc.en: Smoke from burning wood or leaves

note.zh: 湘式、川式腊肉的柴火烟熏味：愈创木酚是主角。
note.en: Hunan- and Sichuan-style larou, smoked over wood fires: guaiacol leads.

desc.zh: 饱满圆润的深色烘烤感
desc.en: A full, round, dark roasted note

note.zh: 烤馒头片：面香加焦边。
note.en: Toasted steamed-bun slices: bready with browned edges.

desc.zh: 谷物：浅褐、带尘、微甜
desc.en: Grains: light brown, dusty, slightly sweet

desc.zh: 谷物感再加一点酸和发酵感
desc.en: Grainy, with a little sourness and fermentation

desc.zh: 鼻腔里尖锐、穿透性的刺激感
desc.en: A sharp, penetrating sensation in the nose

desc.zh: 黑胡椒粉：辛、冲、带霉木感
desc.en: Ground black pepper: spicy, pungent, musty-woody

desc.zh: 肉桂、丁香、肉豆蔻一类甜暖香料
desc.en: Sweet, warm spices such as cinnamon, clove and nutmeg

desc.zh: 原文为洋茴香（茴芹），气味与八角相近
desc.en: Aniseed; close in smell to star anise

note.zh: 肉豆蔻的标志成分肉豆蔻醚（myristicin）未见在生豆或烘焙咖啡中的报道，也没有找到把任何咖啡挥发物与“肉豆蔻”描述联系起来的研究，因此暂不对应分子。
note.en: Myristicin, the marker of nutmeg, has not been reported in green or roasted coffee, and no study linking any coffee volatile to a nutmeg note was found, so no compound is assigned.

note.zh: 肉桂的特征成分 (E)-肉桂醛在几项研究中被检出，但只是质谱 / 保留指数鉴定、含量低，没有嗅闻证据（Gantner 2024 等）；糠醛在香料文献中被描述为“肉桂-杏仁样”（Lopes 2021 汇总），在咖啡粉中很强、咖啡液中却低于阈值。两者都只能算线索。
note.en: (E)-Cinnamaldehyde, the key cinnamon odorant, has been detected in a few studies, but only by MS/retention index at low levels and without olfactometry (Gantner 2024 and others); furfural carries a 'cinnamon-almond' descriptor in flavour references (compiled by Lopes 2021) but is below threshold in the brew. Both are only leads.

desc.zh: 即巴旦木

note.zh: 2-糠硫醇是炒芝麻最强的香气之一，也是刚冲好咖啡那股焦香。
note.en: 2-Furfurylthiol is among the strongest odorants of toasted sesame — and of fresh-brewed coffee.

note.zh: 街头铁锅里的糖炒栗子：甜、粉、带焦糖香。
note.en: Street-wok chestnuts roasted with sugar: sweet, mealy, caramelized.

note.zh: 可可粉的关键香气：麦芽醛、“薯片味”吡嗪和苯乙醛。
note.en: Key odorants of cocoa powder: malty aldehydes, a potato-chip pyrazine and phenylacetaldehyde.

desc.zh: 深色焦糖调，略尖锐，可带硫味
desc.en: Dark caramel notes, slightly sharp, sometimes sulfury

note.zh: 未精制的黑糖块：比红糖更深、更焦香。
note.en: Unrefined black sugar: darker and toastier than brown sugar.

note.zh: 麦芽糖稀：中国传统的谷物糖浆。
note.en: Maltose syrup, the traditional Chinese grain syrup.

desc.zh: 熬煮的糖，不含焦糊味
desc.en: Cooked sugar, without burnt notes

note.zh: 冬天街头的烤红薯：焦糖化的糖与淀粉香。
note.en: Winter street-stall sweet potatoes: caramelized sugar and starch.

desc.zh: 又称香草醛，香草的主要香气成分
desc.en: The main aroma compound of vanilla

desc.zh: 甜味与甜香的综合感受
desc.en: The combined impression of sweet taste and sweet aroma

desc.zh: 闻起来“偏甜”的香气印象
desc.en: An aroma that smells “sweet”

compare.zh: 柠檬肉的印象主要是柠檬酸带来的明亮酸味，香气只有淡淡的柠檬烯；柠檬皮是皮油：柠檬烯更浓，还有辛醛、癸醛这类带蜡质感的醛，香而不酸，略带苦。
compare.en: Lemon flesh reads mostly as the bright sourness of citric acid, with only a light limonene top note. Zest is peel oil: more limonene plus waxy aldehydes such as octanal and decanal — aromatic, slightly bitter, not sour.

compare.zh: 橙肉是酸甜：柠檬酸加少量柠檬烯与醛；橙皮是皮油：柠檬烯为主，癸醛带来蜡质、略像肥皂的皮味，没有酸。
compare.en: Orange flesh is sweet-sour: citric acid with a little limonene and aldehydes. The peel is oil: limonene first, with decanal adding a waxy, faintly soapy rind note — and no sourness.

compare.zh: 鲜榨橙汁的关键香气除了辛醛、癸醛，还有丁酸乙酯、乙醛这类“新鲜果汁感”的成分，加上柠檬酸的酸；皮油里的柠檬烯反而退居次要。
compare.en: Fresh orange juice owes its key aroma to octanal and decanal plus “fresh-juice” compounds such as ethyl butanoate and acetaldehyde, with citric acid for sourness; peel-oil limonene plays a smaller part.

compare.zh: 两者在咖啡分子层面都以柠檬烯为主。新鲜橙皮多了癸醛那种刚剥开的蜡质皮味；陈皮更温和，柠檬烯旁边是芳樟醇。
compare.en: On coffee’s molecules both are limonene-led. Fresh orange peel adds decanal’s waxy, just-peeled edge; chenpi is milder, with linalool beside the limonene.

compare.zh: 青苹果的“青”来自乙醛、丙醛这类冲鼻的生青醛，加上苹果酸的尖酸；成熟苹果偏甜的果香来自 2-甲基丁酸甲酯等酯类。
compare.en: The “green” of green apple is sharp aldehydes — acetaldehyde, propanal — plus the tartness of malic acid. A ripe apple’s sweeter fruitiness comes from esters such as methyl 2-methylbutanoate.

compare.zh: 苹果一加热，类胡萝卜素降解出 β-大马士酮，香气就从新鲜的酯香变成果酱、苹果派般的熟甜，易挥发的鲜果酯则散失。
compare.en: Heating an apple breaks carotenoids down into β-damascenone, turning fresh ester fruitiness into jammy, apple-pie sweetness while the volatile fresh esters fade.

compare.zh: 在咖啡的分子里两者是同一个 β-大马士酮；苹果酱更甜、更绵，差别在糖和质地，不在香气分子。
compare.en: In coffee terms both are the same β-damascenone; applesauce is sweeter and softer — a difference of sugar and texture rather than aroma molecule.

compare.zh: 两者都靠内酯。γ-壬内酯给出椰肉那种甜的椰香；椰奶的乳脂圆润更接近 δ-癸内酯——黄油、奶油的醇厚也有它。
compare.en: Both rest on lactones. γ-Nonalactone gives the sweet coconut-flesh note; coconut milk’s fatty roundness is closer to δ-decalactone, which also gives butter and cream their richness.

compare.zh: 樱桃果肉里苯甲醛只是一层杏仁感，被芳樟醇等花果香包着；樱桃核（和苦杏仁）几乎就是纯粹的苯甲醛，由果核里的苦杏仁苷分解而来。
compare.en: In cherry flesh, benzaldehyde is only an almond shade wrapped in floral-fruity notes such as linalool; the pit, like bitter almond, is nearly pure benzaldehyde, released from amygdalin in the kernel.

compare.zh: 苦杏仁是浓烈的苯甲醛；咖啡里的“杏仁”更温和，是少量苯甲醛加上糠醛、5-甲基糠醛的烘烤甜香，像烤过的甜杏仁。
compare.en: Bitter almond is concentrated benzaldehyde. Coffee’s “almond” is gentler: a little benzaldehyde with the toasty sweetness of furfural and 5-methylfurfural, like roasted sweet almonds.

compare.zh: 新鲜覆盆子是覆盆子酮加一点 β-紫罗兰酮的紫罗兰花香；熬成果酱后花香弱了，呋喃酮那种熬糖的熟甜占上风。
compare.en: Fresh raspberry is raspberry ketone with a violet hint of β-ionone; cooked into jam, the floral lift fades and furaneol’s cooked-sugar sweetness takes over.

compare.zh: 在咖啡的分子里，杨梅和覆盆子靠的是同一组：覆盆子酮加呋喃酮；杨梅自己那股树脂感来自咖啡里没有记录的成分。
compare.en: On coffee’s molecules, yangmei and raspberry share the same pair, raspberry ketone and furaneol; yangmei’s own resinous edge comes from compounds not recorded in coffee.

compare.zh: 真菠萝是 2-甲基丁酸乙酯的鲜果香、异丁酸乙酯的热带甜，再加呋喃酮的熟甜；菠萝味水果糖主要是丁酸乙酯，甜而单调，没有熟果的厚度。
compare.en: Real pineapple combines ethyl 2-methylbutanoate (fresh), ethyl 2-methylpropanoate (tropical) and furaneol (ripe sweetness); pineapple candy is mainly ethyl butanoate — sweet and simple, without the ripe depth.

compare.zh: 鲜荔枝玫瑰般的“提香”来自香叶醇；只剩异丁酸乙酯那种甜润的酯香时，就更像糖水荔枝罐头。
compare.en: Fresh lychee’s rose-like lift is geraniol; with only the sweet ester ethyl 2-methylpropanoate left, it reads as syrupy canned lychee.

compare.zh: 玫瑰花瓣和玫瑰精油以香叶醇为主，鲜亮带柑橘感；苯乙醇易溶于水，蒸馏时留在花水里，所以玫瑰花水是更柔和、带蜂蜜感的苯乙醇玫瑰。
compare.en: Rose petals and rose oil are geraniol-led, bright and citrusy. Phenylethanol dissolves in water and stays in the distillate, so rosewater is the softer, honeyed phenylethanol rose.

compare.zh: 在咖啡的分子里两者一样：芳樟醇为主，配一点吲哚。茉莉花茶多的是绿茶的茶底，茉莉花自己的乙酸苄酯也不在本资料中。
compare.en: On coffee’s molecules they are the same: linalool with a touch of indole. Jasmine tea adds a green-tea base, and jasmine’s own benzyl acetate is not in this dataset.

compare.zh: 在咖啡里两者都只体现为芳樟醇的淡淡花草香；真实的洋甘菊和菊花各有自己的萜类，但不在咖啡记录的香气物质之中。
compare.en: In coffee both show only as linalool’s light herbal-floral note; real chamomile and chrysanthemum each have their own terpenes, which are not among coffee’s recorded odorants.

compare.zh: 蜂蜜甜的花香主要是苯乙醛；蜂蜡那种温暖、略带动物感的蜡香是苯乙酸。
compare.en: Honey’s sweet floral note is mainly phenylacetaldehyde; the warm, slightly animal waxiness of beeswax is phenylacetic acid.

compare.zh: 焦糖以呋喃酮为主，还有甲基环戊烯醇酮的枫糖感；棉花糖主要是麦芽酚，更轻，像烤过的糖丝，没有焦糖的厚重。
compare.en: Caramel is furaneol-led, with cyclotene’s maple tone; cotton candy is mainly maltol — lighter, like toasted spun sugar, without caramel’s depth.

compare.zh: 枫糖浆的特征来自葫芦巴内酯和甲基环戊烯醇酮（浓时偏咖喱、葫芦巴）；麦芽糖稀是麦芽酚和呋喃酮的谷物甜，没有那股调料感。
compare.en: Maple syrup’s signature is sotolon and cyclotene (curry- and fenugreek-like when strong); maltose syrup is the grainy sweetness of maltol and furaneol, without that spice edge.

compare.zh: 两者都是呋喃酮的熬糖香加葫芦巴内酯的深色甜；这里的糖蜜还多列了乙基呋喃酮，即酱油里那种更“酱”的焦糖香。
compare.en: Both pair furaneol’s cooked sugar with sotolon’s dark sweetness; molasses here also lists HEMF, the deeper, soy-sauce-like caramel.

compare.zh: 香兰素是香草的主要香气成分，单独闻是干净的香草甜；真正的香草荚还有上百种别的成分，香草冰淇淋再加上乳脂的 δ-癸内酯。
compare.en: Vanillin is the main aroma compound of vanilla and smells cleanly sweet on its own; a real vanilla bean has hundreds more compounds, and vanilla ice cream adds the dairy lactone δ-decalactone.

compare.zh: 生花生的青豆气在这里由 2-异丁基-3-甲氧基吡嗪代表，甲氧基吡嗪是生豆类的典型；一炒，美拉德反应生成 2,5-二甲基吡嗪等烷基吡嗪，就成了炒花生香。
compare.en: Raw peanut’s green, pea-like note is represented here by 2-isobutyl-3-methoxypyrazine; methoxypyrazines are typical of raw legumes. Roasting builds alkylpyrazines such as 2,5-dimethylpyrazine through the Maillard reaction, giving the roasted-peanut smell.

compare.zh: 生榛子是 2,3-二乙基-5-甲基吡嗪和 2-甲氧基-3,5-二甲基吡嗪，带泥土、霉土气；烤榛子则是 2-乙基-3,6-二甲基吡嗪的烘烤坚果香更突出。
compare.en: Raw hazelnut is 2,3-diethyl-5-methylpyrazine and 2-methoxy-3,5-dimethylpyrazine, earthy and musty; in roasted hazelnut the toasted-nut 2-ethyl-3,6-dimethylpyrazine comes forward.

compare.zh: 两者都有 3-甲基丁醛的麦芽可可香和“薯片味”吡嗪；黑巧克力多了 2,3-二乙基-5-甲基吡嗪的泥土烘烤感和二甲基三硫醚那股闷闷的硫味，更深、更苦。
compare.en: Both share 3-methylbutanal’s malty cocoa and the potato-chip pyrazine; dark chocolate adds the earthy roast of 2,3-diethyl-5-methylpyrazine and the muted sulfur of dimethyl trisulfide — deeper and more bitter.

compare.zh: 爆米花的焦香是乙酰基四氢吡啶和 2-乙酰基-1-吡咯啉；淋上黄油就多了双乙酰的奶油香。
compare.en: Popcorn’s toasty note is acetyltetrahydropyridine and 2-acetyl-1-pyrroline; butter adds diacetyl.

compare.zh: 黄油是双乙酰、2,3-戊二酮的浓郁黄油香；奶油是乙偶姻和 δ-癸内酯，更淡，像乳脂而不那么“黄油”。
compare.en: Butter is the rich note of diacetyl and 2,3-pentanedione; cream is acetoin and δ-decalactone — milder, milky-fatty rather than buttery.

compare.zh: 柴火烟是愈创木酚加 4-甲基愈创木酚，偏甜、接近香草；烟熏腊肉、火腿多了 4-乙基愈创木酚，带丁香、酱油般的辛香。
compare.en: Wood smoke is guaiacol with 4-methylguaiacol, sweetish and close to vanilla; smoked pork and ham add 4-ethylguaiacol, with a clove- and soy-like spiciness.

compare.zh: 德式小麦啤酒的丁香味和丁香、咖啡里的是同一个分子：4-乙烯基愈创木酚。
compare.en: The clove note of German wheat beer is the same molecule as in cloves and coffee: 4-vinylguaiacol.

compare.zh: 臭鼬味和啤酒的日光臭是 3-甲基-2-丁烯-1-硫醇；臭鸡蛋更接近甲硫醇（真正的臭鸡蛋还有硫化氢）。
compare.en: Skunky and lightstruck beer are 3-methyl-2-butene-1-thiol; rotten egg is closer to methanethiol (real rotten eggs also have hydrogen sulfide).

compare.zh: 同一类硫醇酯：极淡时是黑醋栗的果香，浓了就是猫尿味。
compare.en: The same thiol ester: faint, it reads as blackcurrant; strong, as cat pee.

compare.zh: 两者是同一个 2-糠硫醇，所以刚冲好的咖啡和刚炒的芝麻闻起来这么像。
compare.en: Both are 2-furfurylthiol, which is why fresh coffee and toasted sesame smell so alike.

compare.zh: 纸板味本身是脂肪氧化产生的 (E)-2-壬烯醛；受潮发霉的纸箱再加上三氯苯甲醚的霉味。
compare.en: Cardboard itself is (E)-2-nonenal, from fat oxidation; damp, moldy cardboard adds the mustiness of TCA.

compare.zh: 两者都来自氯代酚 / 氯代苯甲醚：碘酒般的药味主要是 2,6-二氯苯酚，“里约味”和木塞味的霉药味是三氯苯甲醚。
compare.en: Both come from chlorophenols and chloroanisoles: the iodine-like medicinal note is mainly 2,6-dichlorophenol, while Rioy and cork taint are TCA.

compare.zh: 雨后泥土、甜菜根是土臭素；自来水、池塘水的“土霉味”是 2-甲基异莰醇，更霉，带樟脑感。
compare.en: Petrichor and beetroot are geosmin; the musty taste of tap and pond water is 2-methylisoborneol, mustier and slightly camphor-like.

compare.zh: 新鲜蘑菇的味道是 1-辛烯-3-醇；1-辛烯-3-酮更冲，带金属感。香菇特有的含硫香气（香菇香精）在咖啡中没有记录。
compare.en: Fresh mushroom is 1-octen-3-ol; 1-octen-3-one is sharper and metallic. Shiitake’s own sulfur aroma, lenthionine, is not recorded in coffee.

compare.zh: 生土豆的青土气是 2-异丙基-3-甲氧基吡嗪；煮熟后的土豆香是由蛋氨酸降解而来的甲硫基丙醛。
compare.en: Raw potato’s earthy-green note is 2-isopropyl-3-methoxypyrazine; cooked potato is methional, formed from methionine.

compare.zh: 煮土豆是甲硫基丙醛；薯片的焦香来自油炸烘烤生成的 2-乙基-3,5-二甲基吡嗪。
compare.en: Boiled potato is methional; potato chips get their roasty crunch from 2-ethyl-3,5-dimethylpyrazine formed in frying.

compare.zh: 薯片突出的是吡嗪的烘烤焦香；炸薯条突出的是 (E,E)-2,4-癸二烯醛那种油炸油脂香。
compare.en: Potato chips lead with roasty pyrazines; French fries lead with the deep-fried fat note of (E,E)-2,4-decadienal.

compare.zh: 肉汤、炖牛肉是 2-甲基-3-呋喃硫醇；它两两结合成的双(2-甲基-3-呋喃基)二硫醚更浓、更甜，像红烧肉。
compare.en: Broth and stewed beef are 2-methyl-3-furanthiol; joined in pairs it becomes bis(2-methyl-3-furyl) disulfide, richer and sweeter, like red-braised pork.

compare.zh: 煮出来的肉香是呋喃硫醇；烤肉表皮的焦香是 2-乙酰基-2-噻唑啉。
compare.en: Boiled meat smells of furanthiols; the browned crust of roast meat is 2-acetyl-2-thiazoline.

compare.zh: 清香型以乙酸乙酯、乳酸乙酯为主体；浓香型以己酸乙酯等果香酯为主（己酸乙酯不在本资料中，这里列的是咖啡里也有的异戊酸乙酯、丁酸乙酯和己酸）。
compare.en: Light-aroma baijiu is built on ethyl acetate and ethyl lactate; strong-aroma baijiu on fruity esters led by ethyl hexanoate (not in this dataset — listed here are the coffee-shared ethyl 3-methylbutanoate, ethyl butanoate and hexanoic acid).

zh.name: 芳樟醇
zh.odor: 干净明亮的花香，带柠檬皮般的柑橘感，像茉莉花茶、薰衣草。R 型比 S 型灵敏得多。
zh.coffee: 生豆里天然就有，部分以糖苷形式存在、烘焙时释放。埃塞俄比亚水洗豆中 OAV 约 200，缺省实验中去掉它花香明显变弱；日晒和保留较多果胶的蜜处理生豆中也偏高。

en.name: Linalool
en.odor: Clean, bright floral note with a lemon-peel citrus edge, like jasmine tea or lavender. The R-form is far more potent than the S-form.
en.coffee: Occurs naturally in green beans, partly as glycosides that release it during roasting. In washed Ethiopian coffee its OAV is about 200, and removing it in an omission test clearly weakens the floral note. It is also relatively high in natural and in high-mucilage honey-process green beans.

zh.name: 乙酸芳樟酯
zh.odor: 佛手柑、薰衣草般清甜的柑橘花香；佛手柑精油的主要成分之一。
zh.coffee: 巴拿马瑰夏不同烘焙曲线之间差异显著，在偏柑橘、佛手柑印象的那组最高；在其他咖啡中报道很少。

en.name: Linalyl acetate
en.odor: Fresh, sweet citrus-floral note like bergamot or lavender; one of the main components of bergamot oil.
en.coffee: Differs significantly among roast profiles of Panama Geisha and is highest in the group with the most citrus and bergamot character; rarely reported in other coffees.

zh.name: 香叶醇
zh.alt: 牻牛儿醇（注意：与青草味的“叶醇”不是一种物质）
zh.odor: 甜润的玫瑰花香带柑橘感，像玫瑰花瓣、荔枝果肉。
zh.coffee: 生豆中以糖苷形式存在。巴拿马瑰夏中花香最强的烘焙组含量最高，但缺少感官验证，作用尚不确定。

en.name: Geraniol
en.alt: Not to be confused with grassy-smelling leaf alcohol, (Z)-3-hexen-1-ol
en.odor: Smooth, sweet rose note with a citrus touch, like rose petals or lychee flesh.
foods: Rose (a main component of the essential oil)
en.coffee: Present in green beans as glycosides. In Panama Geisha it is highest in the roast group with the strongest floral note, but without sensory validation its role remains uncertain.

zh.name: 乙酸-2-苯乙酯
zh.odor: 带蜂蜜感的玫瑰花香，比苯乙醇更甜、更果香。
zh.coffee: 酵母发酵的产物：接种酵母发酵的生豆中升高，烘焙后仍能保留，被看作“酵母主导的良好发酵”的标志之一；但在巴西缺陷豆中也被列为低品质指标之一。

en.name: 2-Phenylethyl acetate
en.odor: Honeyed rose note, sweeter and fruitier than phenylethanol.
en.coffee: A product of yeast fermentation: it rises in green beans from yeast-inoculated fermentation, survives roasting, and is seen as one marker of “good, yeast-driven fermentation.” Yet in Brazilian defective beans it is also listed as one of the indicators of low quality.

zh.name: β-紫罗兰酮
zh.cls: 降异戊二烯（类胡萝卜素降解物）
zh.odor: 紫罗兰花香，带木质和覆盆子感，粉粉的。
zh.coffee: 由类胡萝卜素氧化裂解而来。烘焙咖啡顶空中有检出；保留较多果胶的云南蜜处理生豆中，它和芳樟醇是主要花香来源。

en.name: β-Ionone
en.odor: Violet floral note with woody and raspberry hints; powdery.
en.coffee: Formed by oxidative cleavage of carotenoids. Detected in the headspace of roasted coffee; in Yunnan honey-process green beans that retain more mucilage, it and linalool are the main sources of floral aroma.

zh.name: 苯乙醛
zh.odor: 浓郁的蜂蜜、花蜜香；浓时略带青涩的化学感。
zh.coffee: 苯丙氨酸的 Strecker 降解产物。烘焙阿拉比卡的粉和咖啡液中都检出“蜂蜜味”，阿拉比卡高于罗布斯塔。

en.name: Phenylacetaldehyde
en.odor: Rich honey and nectar aroma; slightly green and chemical when concentrated.
en.coffee: A Strecker degradation product of phenylalanine. Detected as a “honey” odor in both ground roasted Arabica and its brew; higher in Arabica than in Robusta.

zh.name: 苯乙酸
zh.odor: 温暖的蜂蜜、蜂蜡香，带一点动物感。
zh.coffee: 苯乙醛进一步氧化的产物（有氧、偏碱性时更多）。只在一项研究的烘焙豆中以高稀释因子（FD 512）检出“蜂蜜味”，未定量。

en.name: Phenylacetic acid
en.odor: Warm honey and beeswax note with a slight animal touch.
en.coffee: Formed by further oxidation of phenylacetaldehyde (more so under aerobic, slightly alkaline conditions). Detected as a “honey” odor at a high flavor dilution factor (FD 512) in the roasted beans of only one study; not quantified.

zh.name: 4-甲氧基苯甲醛（茴香醛）
zh.odor: 像洋茴香、八角那类的甜香，带一点薄荷感。
zh.coffee: Grosch 团队在阿拉比卡粉和咖啡液中检出，描述为“甜、薄荷样”；其他研究很少报道。

en.name: 4-Methoxybenzaldehyde (p-anisaldehyde)
en.odor: Sweet aroma like anise or star anise, with a slight minty touch.
foods: Rapeseed honey (one of the strong odorants)
en.coffee: Detected by Grosch’s group in ground Arabica and its brew and described as “sweet, minty”; rarely reported in other studies.

zh.name: (E)-β-大马士酮
zh.cls: 降异戊二烯（类胡萝卜素降解物）
zh.alt: 常被称作 β-大马酮，严格地说那是另一物质
zh.odor: 煮苹果、苹果酱般的熟果甜香，带蜂蜜和红茶感。
foods: 吐鲁番葡萄干（主要香气之一）
zh.coffee: 类胡萝卜素降解产物，烘焙中大幅增加。在烘焙阿拉比卡粉中 OAV 排第一（约 27 万），但缺省实验中去掉它影响不显著——更像铺底的甜果香。生豆在温湿条件下储存也会增多。

en.name: (E)-β-Damascenone
en.alt: Not to be confused with β-damascone, a different compound
en.odor: Ripe, cooked-fruit sweetness like stewed apple or applesauce, with honey and black-tea notes.
foods: Turpan (Xinjiang) raisins (one of the main odorants)
en.coffee: A carotenoid degradation product that increases greatly during roasting. It ranks first by OAV in ground roasted Arabica (about 270,000), yet removing it in an omission test had no significant effect—it acts more like a sweet, fruity backdrop. It also increases when green beans are stored in warm, humid conditions.

zh.name: 4-(4-羟基苯基)-2-丁酮（覆盆子酮）
zh.odor: 覆盆子、莓果酱般的甜果香。
foods: 覆盆子（以它命名的特征香气）
zh.coffee: 在新冲咖啡的顶空中被检出，是埃塞俄比亚咖啡的特征香气之一，浅烘埃塞最高；在坦桑尼亚、危地马拉咖啡中加入接近阈值的量，香气就更“甜”、更像埃塞。

en.name: 4-(4-Hydroxyphenyl)-2-butanone (raspberry ketone)
en.odor: Sweet fruitiness of raspberries and berry jam.
foods: Raspberry (the character odorant it is named after)
en.coffee: Detected in the headspace of freshly brewed coffee; one of the characteristic odorants of Ethiopian coffee, highest in light-roast Ethiopians. Adding a near-threshold amount to Tanzanian or Guatemalan coffee makes the aroma “sweeter” and more Ethiopian-like.

zh.name: 3-甲基丁酸乙酯（异戊酸乙酯）
zh.odor: 蓝莓、熟浆果般的甜果香，浓了带酒香。
foods: 浓香型白酒（五粮液、剑南春的重要香气）
zh.coffee: 生豆中 OAV 排第三；保留果胶的蜜处理生豆中更多；过量则是发酵过度“臭豆”（stinker）的成分之一。在烘焙咖啡中的作用尚未定量。

en.name: Ethyl 3-methylbutanoate (ethyl isovalerate)
en.odor: Sweet, ripe-berry fruitiness like blueberry; winey when concentrated.
foods: Strong-aroma baijiu (Chinese grain spirit; an important odorant of the Wuliangye and Jiannanchun brands)
en.coffee: Ranks third by OAV in green beans and is higher in honey-process green beans that retain mucilage; in excess it is one of the components of over-fermented “stinker” beans. Its role in roasted coffee has not been quantified.

zh.name: 3-甲基丁酸甲酯（异戊酸甲酯）
zh.odor: 清新的苹果、鲜果香。
zh.coffee: 危地马拉精品豆中与杯测分数相关性最高的物质；往咖啡液里加入它，果香和“干净度”都提高。生豆在温湿环境储存时会大量增加，成为陈放生豆的“果香”。

en.name: Methyl 3-methylbutanoate (methyl isovalerate)
en.odor: Fresh apple and fresh-fruit note.
en.coffee: In Guatemalan specialty coffees, the compound most strongly correlated with cupping score; adding it to the brew raises both fruitiness and “cleanness.” It increases sharply when green beans are stored in warm, humid conditions, becoming the “fruity” note of aged green beans.

zh.name: 2-甲基丁酸甲酯
zh.odor: 苹果般的鲜果香。
zh.coffee: 生豆在 40 °C、含水 13.5% 下储存时，它和异戊酸甲酯从每千克几微克升到毫克级，是陈放生豆“果香”的主因；含水量越低越不易生成。

en.name: Methyl 2-methylbutanoate
en.odor: Fresh, apple-like fruitiness.
en.coffee: When green beans are stored at 40 °C and 13.5% moisture, it and methyl 3-methylbutanoate rise from a few micrograms per kilogram to the milligram level, the main cause of the “fruity” note in aged green beans; the lower the moisture content, the less of it forms.

zh.name: 2-甲基丁酸乙酯
zh.odor: 青苹果、菠萝般的鲜甜果香；过量就成了发酵过头的烂水果味。
foods: 菠萝（特征香气，缺省实验证实）
zh.coffee: 生豆中的强香气物质；在发酵过度的“臭豆”里显著升高。在烘焙咖啡中的作用尚未定量。

en.name: Ethyl 2-methylbutanoate
en.odor: Fresh, sweet fruitiness like green apple or pineapple; in excess it becomes the rotten-fruit smell of over-fermentation.
foods: Pineapple (character odorant, confirmed by omission test)
en.coffee: A potent odorant in green beans; markedly elevated in over-fermented “stinker” beans. Its role in roasted coffee has not been quantified.

zh.name: 2-甲基丙酸乙酯（异丁酸乙酯）
zh.odor: 甜润的热带果香，像菠萝、荔枝罐头。
zh.coffee: 早年在发酵过度的“臭豆”中检出；2026 年一项研究发现它在烘焙咖啡中 OAV > 1，酯类比例随烘焙加深而下降。咖啡中的证据仍少。

en.name: Ethyl 2-methylpropanoate (ethyl isobutyrate)
en.odor: Smooth, sweet tropical fruitiness, like canned pineapple or lychee.
en.coffee: Detected in early work on over-fermented “stinker” beans; a 2026 study found an OAV > 1 in roasted coffee, with the share of esters falling as the roast gets darker. Evidence in coffee is still limited.

zh.name: 丁酸乙酯
zh.odor: 像菠萝味水果糖、苹果的甜果香。
zh.coffee: 保留果胶的蜜处理生豆中高 2–4 倍，也见于发酵过度的“臭豆”。烘焙后是否仍在，尚未确认。

en.name: Ethyl butanoate
en.odor: Sweet fruitiness like pineapple-flavored fruit candy or apple.
foods: Strong-aroma baijiu (Chinese grain spirit; important odorant)
en.coffee: 2–4 times higher in honey-process green beans that retain mucilage; also found in over-fermented “stinker” beans. Whether it survives roasting has not been confirmed.

zh.name: 乙酸异戊酯
zh.odor: 熟香蕉味，也像“香蕉水”（稀释剂）。
zh.coffee: 酵母发酵的产物，接种酵母的湿法发酵中大量生成，被视为“酵母主导、控制良好的发酵”的标志；但大部分会在烘焙中损失。

en.name: Isoamyl acetate
en.odor: Ripe banana; also like lacquer thinner (“banana water”).
en.coffee: A product of yeast fermentation, formed in large amounts in yeast-inoculated wet fermentation and regarded as a marker of “yeast-driven, well-controlled fermentation”; however, most of it is lost during roasting.

zh.name: γ-壬内酯
zh.odor: 椰子、椰奶般的奶油甜香。
zh.coffee: 仅一项研究：危地马拉日晒豆的烘焙豆中以很高的稀释因子（FD 1024）检出“果香、椰子”，未定量。

en.name: γ-Nonalactone
en.alt: Coconut aldehyde (flavor and fragrance trade name)
en.odor: Creamy sweetness of coconut and coconut milk.
en.coffee: Only one study: detected as “fruity, coconut” at a very high flavor dilution factor (FD 1024) in roasted beans of a Guatemalan natural; not quantified.

zh.name: 柠檬烯
zh.odor: 新鲜橙皮、柠檬皮的柑橘香，像剥橘子时喷出的皮油。
zh.coffee: 由咖啡自身的萜烯合成酶生成，受处理方式影响小。瑰夏的生豆和熟豆中都明显高于其他品种，与它的橙子、柑橘调性有关；非洲生豆普遍较高。

en.name: Limonene
en.odor: Fresh citrus of orange and lemon peel, like the oil that sprays out when you peel a tangerine.
foods: Dried tangerine peel and dried immature (green) tangerine peel (main component)
en.coffee: Made by the coffee plant’s own terpene synthases and little affected by processing. Clearly higher in both green and roasted Geisha than in other varieties, linked to its orange and citrus character; African green beans are generally high in it.

zh.name: 辛醛
zh.odor: 柠檬皮般的青柑橘味，浓了带油脂、肥皂感。
zh.coffee: 顶空 GC-O 首次确认它对咖啡液香气有贡献；生熟豆都有，含量不高。

en.name: Octanal
en.odor: Green citrus like lemon peel; fatty and soapy when concentrated.
en.coffee: Headspace GC-O first confirmed that it contributes to brew aroma; present in both green and roasted beans, at low levels.

zh.name: 癸醛
zh.odor: 橙皮的蜡质油香，浓了像肥皂。
zh.coffee: 生熟豆中都有。巴拿马瑰夏中随烘焙曲线变化，可能参与柑橘、佛手柑印象（仅相关性证据）。

en.name: Decanal
en.odor: Waxy, oily orange-peel note; soapy when concentrated.
en.coffee: Present in both green and roasted beans. In Panama Geisha it varies with roast profile and may contribute to the citrus and bergamot impression (correlational evidence only).

zh.name: 苯甲醛
zh.odor: 苦杏仁、杏仁膏般的气味，也像樱桃核。
foods: 苦杏仁（苦杏仁油的主要成分）
zh.coffee: 烘焙咖啡中 OAV < 1。生豆中多见于日晒、受氧或缺陷豆，被看作生豆劣变的早期指标。

en.name: Benzaldehyde
en.odor: Bitter almond and marzipan; also like cherry pits.
foods: Bitter almond (main component of bitter almond oil)
en.coffee: OAV < 1 in roasted coffee. In green beans it shows up mostly in naturals and in oxygen-exposed or defective beans, and is seen as an early indicator of green-bean deterioration.

zh.name: 乙醛
zh.odor: 冲鼻又清新的生青果香，像刚切开的青苹果；浓时刺鼻。
zh.coffee: 缺省实验证实，它是烘焙阿拉比卡香气中影响最大的物质之一；75% 以上进入咖啡液，让新鲜咖啡的香气显得轻盈上扬。主要来自烘焙中糖的裂解，咖啡果发酵也会产生。

en.name: Acetaldehyde
en.odor: Sharp yet fresh green-fruit note, like a freshly cut green apple; pungent when concentrated.
en.coffee: Omission tests confirm it as one of the most influential compounds in roasted Arabica aroma; over 75% passes into the brew, giving fresh coffee a light, lifted aroma. It comes mainly from sugar fragmentation during roasting; fermentation of the coffee cherry also produces it.

zh.name: 丙醛
zh.odor: 清新的果香带一点麦芽感，挥发极快。
zh.coffee: 与乙醛一起，在缺省实验中被证明是对烘焙阿拉比卡香气影响最大的物质之一。

en.name: Propanal
en.odor: Fresh fruitiness with a slight malty touch; extremely volatile.
en.coffee: Together with acetaldehyde, shown in omission tests to be among the most influential compounds in roasted Arabica aroma.

zh.name: 乙酸乙酯
zh.odor: 淡时是清爽的果香，浓了就是指甲油、洗甲水般的溶剂味。
foods: 清香型白酒（汾酒类的主体香，缺省实验证实）
zh.coffee: 咖啡果发酵中含量最高的酯，被视为果肉处理得当、酵母主导发酵的标志；量很大时出现溶剂味。阈值很高，在烘焙咖啡里不是关键香气。

en.name: Ethyl acetate
en.odor: Clean fruitiness when faint; when concentrated, a solvent smell like nail polish or nail-polish remover.
foods: Light-aroma baijiu (Chinese grain spirit; the dominant aroma of Fenjiu-type baijiu, confirmed by omission test)
en.coffee: The most abundant ester in coffee-cherry fermentation, regarded as a marker of well-handled fruit and yeast-driven fermentation; in large amounts it gives a solvent note. Its threshold is high, so it is not a key odorant in roasted coffee.

zh.name: 甲酸乙酯
zh.odor: 刺鼻的溶剂味，带一点朗姆酒感。
zh.coffee: 用非靶向化学计量学筛出的“发酵异味”标志物，可在烘焙咖啡粉的顶空中测出。

en.name: Ethyl formate
en.odor: Pungent solvent smell with a slight rum-like touch.
en.coffee: A “fermented off-flavor” marker picked out by untargeted chemometrics; measurable in the headspace of ground roasted coffee.

zh.name: 2-苯乙醇
zh.odor: 柔和的玫瑰-蜂蜜香，像玫瑰花水。
foods: 黄酒（绍兴型；关键香气之一）
zh.coffee: 生豆中是较强的花香物质（FD 128），一部分由酵母把苯丙氨酸转化而来；烘焙后作用变小。

en.name: 2-Phenylethanol
en.odor: Soft rose-and-honey aroma, like rosewater.
foods: Shaoxing-type huangjiu (Chinese yellow rice wine; one of the key odorants)
en.coffee: A fairly strong floral odorant in green beans (FD 128), partly formed by yeast from phenylalanine; its role diminishes after roasting.

zh.name: 3-甲基-1-丁醇（异戊醇）
zh.odor: 麦芽、威士忌般的醇香，浓了是刺鼻的杂醇味。
zh.coffee: 健康生豆中的常见挥发物，由酵母从亮氨酸生成，接种酵母发酵会提高；酸败豆中它会转化为 3-甲基丁醛。

en.name: 3-Methyl-1-butanol (isoamyl alcohol)
en.odor: Malty, whiskey-like spirit note; a pungent, fusel-oil smell when concentrated.
foods: Broomcorn-millet huangjiu (Chinese yellow wine; important odorant)
en.coffee: A common volatile in sound green beans, made by yeast from leucine and increased by yeast-inoculated fermentation; in sour beans it is converted to 3-methylbutanal.

zh.name: 乳酸乙酯
zh.odor: 淡淡的果香带奶味，像米酒、黄酒里柔和的酯香。
zh.thr: —（水中阈值未查到，在酒类基质中很高）
zh.coffee: 只在一项研究中出现：莫桑比克 72 小时水洗发酵后的生豆中相对含量约 9%，推测是干燥时乳酸菌产的乳酸与酵母产的乙醇结合而成。

en.name: Ethyl lactate
en.odor: Faint fruitiness with a milky touch, like the mellow ester note of sweet fermented rice (jiuniang) or huangjiu (Chinese yellow rice wine).
foods: Light-aroma baijiu (Chinese grain spirit; important odorant)
en.thr: — (no threshold in water found; very high in alcoholic-beverage matrices)
en.coffee: Reported in only one study: about 9% relative abundance in Mozambican green beans after a 72-hour washed fermentation, presumably formed during drying as lactic acid from lactic acid bacteria combined with ethanol from yeast.

zh.name: 环己甲酸乙酯
zh.odor: 甜腻的果香，稍浓就变成烂水果、青贮饲料般的腐败味。
zh.coffee: 发酵过度的“臭豆”（stinker）里最主要的异味物质，和 2-甲基丁酸乙酯、异戊酸乙酯一起造成让人无法接受的烂果味。

en.name: Ethyl cyclohexanecarboxylate
en.odor: Cloying, sweet fruitiness; a little stronger and it turns into a putrid smell like rotten fruit or silage.
en.coffee: The main off-odorant in over-fermented “stinker” beans; together with ethyl 2-methylbutanoate and ethyl 3-methylbutanoate it produces an unacceptable rotten-fruit smell.

zh.name: 乙酸
zh.odor: 醋味；适量是明亮的酸香，过量就是发酵过头的醋酸味。
foods: 中国四大名醋（区分香气的关键物质之一）
zh.coffee: 烘焙豆中含量最多的挥发物之一，阿拉比卡高于罗布斯塔，浅烘更多。日晒生豆比水洗多；醋酸菌主导的过度发酵会让它大增。在 Grosch 的香气模型里不算关键香气，主要影响“酸”的印象。

en.name: Acetic acid
en.odor: Vinegar; in moderation a bright, tangy acidity, in excess the vinegary note of over-fermentation.
foods: China’s four famous vinegars (one of the key compounds that distinguish their aromas)
en.coffee: One of the most abundant volatiles in roasted beans; higher in Arabica than in Robusta, and higher in light roasts. Natural green beans contain more than washed ones, and over-fermentation dominated by acetic acid bacteria raises it sharply. Not a key odorant in Grosch’s aroma model; it mainly shapes the impression of “acidity.”

zh.name: 3-甲基丁酸
zh.odor: 汗脚、臭袜子味；在咖啡里量极低时，反而给出成熟果香般的“酸甜底子”。
zh.coffee: 缺省实验证实是埃塞俄比亚、云南等咖啡的关键香气之一。生豆里的异戊酰糖苷是它的前体，含量与杯测分数正相关；瑰夏中偏高；水洗会让它减少一半以上。

en.name: 3-Methylbutanoic acid
en.odor: Sweaty feet and smelly socks; at the very low levels found in coffee, it instead gives a ripe-fruit-like “sweet-sour base.”
foods: Sweaty feet (main source of the odor)
Broomcorn-millet huangjiu (Chinese yellow wine; important odorant)
en.coffee: Confirmed by omission tests as one of the key odorants of Ethiopian, Yunnan and other coffees. Isovaleryl glycosides in green beans are its precursors, and their content correlates positively with cupping score; it is relatively high in Geisha, and washing cuts it by more than half.

zh.name: 2-甲基丁酸
zh.odor: 奶酪、汗味，比异戊酸多一点发酵果香。
zh.coffee: 与 3-甲基丁酸一同出现（生豆中两者合计 FD 256）；非洲生豆高于美洲；水洗和蒸汽处理会降低。

en.name: 2-Methylbutanoic acid
en.odor: Cheesy and sweaty, with a bit more fermented-fruit character than isovaleric acid.
en.coffee: Occurs together with 3-methylbutanoic acid (combined FD 256 in green beans); higher in African than in American green beans; reduced by washing and steam treatment.

zh.name: 丁酸
zh.odor: 酸败黄油、帕玛森奶酪味，浓时像汗臭。
foods: 帕玛森奶酪（主要的游离脂肪酸）
zh.coffee: 生豆、烘焙豆和意式浓缩中都有“汗味”描述；浅烘更多，深烘后减少；缺省实验中不显著。快速机械干燥会使它增加。

en.name: Butanoic acid
en.odor: Rancid butter and Parmesan cheese; sweaty when concentrated.
en.coffee: Described as “sweaty” in green beans, roasted beans and espresso; more in light roasts, less after dark roasting; not significant in omission tests. Rapid mechanical drying increases it.

zh.name: 己酸
zh.odor: 羊膻、汗味，像山羊奶酪的膻气。
foods: 浓香型白酒（带“汗味”的香气之一）
zh.coffee: 被提出作为缺陷豆（黑豆、未熟豆、酸豆）的标志物；浅烘更多，深烘后减少。

en.name: Hexanoic acid
en.odor: Goaty and sweaty, like the tang of goat cheese.
foods: Strong-aroma baijiu (Chinese grain spirit; one of its “sweaty” odorants)
en.coffee: Proposed as a marker of defective beans (black, immature and sour beans); more in light roasts, less after dark roasting.

zh.name: 2,3-丁二酮
zh.odor: 黄油、奶油爆米花般的奶香；刚研磨时最明显，散失很快。
zh.coffee: 咖啡液中 OAV 超过 100，阿拉比卡略高于罗布斯塔；与 2,3-戊二酮一同在缺省实验中显示作用。由糖的裂解碎片在烘焙早期重组生成，之后略有分解。极易挥发。

en.name: 2,3-Butanedione (diacetyl)
en.odor: Buttery, butter-popcorn creaminess; most obvious right after grinding and fades quickly.
en.coffee: OAV above 100 in the brew, slightly higher in Arabica than Robusta; together with 2,3-pentanedione it showed an effect in omission tests. Formed early in roasting as sugar fragments recombine, then breaks down slightly. Extremely volatile.

zh.name: 2,3-戊二酮
zh.odor: 和双乙酰相近的黄油、奶油香，略带焦糖甜。
zh.coffee: 咖啡液中 OAV 按旧阈值约 40、按新阈值可达数百；约四分之三来自蔗糖，阿拉比卡明显高于罗布斯塔。

en.name: 2,3-Pentanedione
en.odor: Butter and cream note close to diacetyl, with a slight caramel sweetness.
en.coffee: OAV in the brew is about 40 by the old threshold and up to several hundred by the newer one; about three-quarters comes from sucrose; markedly higher in Arabica than in Robusta.

zh.name: 3-羟基-2-丁酮（乙偶姻）
zh.odor: 淡淡的奶油、黄油味，比双乙酰柔和得多。
zh.coffee: 一项研究的四支阿拉比卡中三支检出，稀释因子低（FD 9），作用有限。

en.name: 3-Hydroxy-2-butanone (acetoin)
en.odor: Faint creamy, buttery note, much softer than diacetyl.
en.coffee: Detected in three of four Arabicas in one study, at a low flavor dilution factor (FD 9); limited role.

zh.name: δ-癸内酯
zh.odor: 奶油、椰奶般的乳脂甜香，带一点桃子味。
zh.coffee: 只有一项意式浓缩的鼻后嗅闻研究报告过（“椰子样”），证据很少。

en.name: δ-Decalactone
en.odor: Creamy, coconut-milk-like milky sweetness with a hint of peach.
en.coffee: Reported only in one retronasal-aroma study of espresso (“coconut-like”); evidence is scant.

zh.name: 4-羟基-2,5-二甲基-3(2H)-呋喃酮
zh.odor: 浓郁的熬糖、焦糖甜香，带熟果感；草莓、菠萝的“熟甜”里也有它。
zh.coffee: 烘焙阿拉比卡中约 100 mg/kg，是含量最高的强香气物质之一；阿拉比卡约为罗布斯塔的 2 倍（咖啡液中 4 倍），是阿拉比卡“甜、柔和”的来源，缺省实验证实影响大。几乎全部由蔗糖的完整碳骨架环化而成，极易溶于水。

en.name: 4-Hydroxy-2,5-dimethyl-3(2H)-furanone (Furaneol, HDMF)
en.odor: Rich cooked-sugar, caramel sweetness with a ripe-fruit touch; it is also part of the “ripe sweetness” of strawberry and pineapple.
en.coffee: About 100 mg/kg in roasted Arabica, making it one of the most abundant potent odorants; Arabica has about 2 times as much as Robusta (4 times in the brew). It is a source of Arabica’s “sweet, smooth” character, and omission tests confirm its large effect. Almost all of it forms by cyclization of the intact carbon skeleton of sucrose; very soluble in water.

zh.name: 2-羟基-3,4-二甲基-2-环戊烯-1-酮
zh.odor: 焦糖、调味料般的甜香。
zh.coffee: Grosch 团队在阿拉比卡粉和咖啡液中发现的焦糖味物质（咖啡液 FD 128），阿拉比卡高于罗布斯塔，属于让阿拉比卡显得“甜、柔和”的那一组。

en.name: 2-Hydroxy-3,4-dimethyl-2-cyclopenten-1-one (3,4-dimethylcyclopentenolone)
en.odor: Sweet caramel and seasoning-like aroma.
en.coffee: A caramel-smelling compound found by Grosch’s group in ground Arabica and its brew (FD 128 in the brew); higher in Arabica than Robusta, and part of the group that makes Arabica seem “sweet, smooth.”

zh.name: 2-羟基-3-甲基-2-环戊烯-1-酮（甲基环戊烯醇酮）
zh.odor: 焦糖、枫糖般的甜香，带汤料感；在咖啡里也被描述成烧纸、烟熏、辛香。
zh.coffee: 一项研究在烘焙豆中以 FD 512 检出；不在 Grosch 团队的关键香气之列，作用不确定。

en.name: 2-Hydroxy-3-methyl-2-cyclopenten-1-one (cyclotene)
en.odor: Sweet caramel and maple-syrup aroma with a brothy note; in coffee also described as burnt paper, smoky or spicy.
en.coffee: Detected at FD 512 in roasted beans in one study; not among the key odorants of Grosch’s group, so its role is uncertain.

zh.name: 4-羟基-2(或5)-乙基-5(或2)-甲基-3(2H)-呋喃酮（HEMF）
zh.odor: 与呋喃酮相似的焦糖甜香，但更厚、更“酱”。
zh.coffee: 阿拉比卡与罗布斯塔含量接近（每千克十几毫克），93% 可进入咖啡液；与呋喃酮一起在缺省实验中影响显著。

en.name: 4-Hydroxy-2(or 5)-ethyl-5(or 2)-methyl-3(2H)-furanone (homofuraneol, HEMF)
en.odor: Caramel sweetness similar to Furaneol, but thicker and more “soy-sauce-like.”
foods: Soy sauce (one of the key odorants)
en.coffee: Arabica and Robusta contain similar amounts (ten-odd milligrams per kilogram), and 93% can pass into the brew; together with Furaneol it had a significant effect in omission tests.

zh.name: 3-羟基-4,5-二甲基-2(5H)-呋喃酮（葫芦巴内酯）
zh.odor: 浓时是葫芦巴、咖喱粉、汤料的调料香；稀了变成焦糖、红糖、枫糖般的甜香。
zh.coffee: 在咖啡液里稀释因子最高（FD 2048），阿拉比卡远高于罗布斯塔；生豆中已有，烘焙中继续增加，78% 进入咖啡液。

en.name: 3-Hydroxy-4,5-dimethyl-2(5H)-furanone (sotolon)
en.odor: Concentrated, it smells like fenugreek, curry powder and soup seasoning; diluted, it turns into a caramel, brown-sugar, maple-syrup sweetness.
foods: Sweet huangjiu (Chinese yellow rice wine; important odorant)
en.thr: 1.7 µg/L (LSB database; literature as low as 0.3)
en.coffee: Has the highest flavor dilution factor in the brew (FD 2048) and is far higher in Arabica than in Robusta; already present in green beans, it keeps increasing during roasting, and 78% passes into the brew.

zh.name: 5-乙基-3-羟基-4-甲基-2(5H)-呋喃酮
zh.odor: 与葫芦巴内酯几乎同味：浓时像葫芦巴、汤料，稀时偏焦糖甜。
zh.coffee: 粉和液中稀释因子都很高（FD 512 / 1024），但含量只有葫芦巴内酯的十分之一左右，OAV 较低；阿拉比卡约为罗布斯塔的 2 倍。

en.name: 5-Ethyl-3-hydroxy-4-methyl-2(5H)-furanone (abhexon)
en.odor: Smells almost the same as sotolon: like fenugreek and soup seasoning when concentrated, caramel-sweet when diluted.
en.coffee: Very high flavor dilution factors in both ground coffee and brew (FD 512 / 1024), but its content is only about one-tenth that of sotolon, so its OAV is lower; Arabica has about 2 times as much as Robusta.

zh.name: 麦芽酚
zh.odor: 温和的焦糖、烤面包皮甜香，常被形容像棉花糖。
zh.coffee: 烘焙越深含量越高；咖啡液中远低于阈值，主要起修饰甜感的作用。

en.name: Maltol
en.odor: Mild caramel and bread-crust sweetness, often likened to cotton candy.
en.coffee: Content rises with roast degree; in the brew it is far below threshold and mainly modulates the sweetness.

zh.name: 香兰素
zh.odor: 香草荚、香草冰淇淋般的甜香。
zh.coffee: 生豆中已有，烘焙中大幅增加；罗布斯塔约为阿拉比卡的 3 倍。几乎全部进入咖啡液，稀释因子从粉里的 32 升到液里的 512——在杯中比在粉里更重要。

en.name: Vanillin
en.odor: Sweet aroma of vanilla bean and vanilla ice cream.
en.coffee: Already present in green beans and increases greatly during roasting; Robusta has about 3 times as much as Arabica. Almost all of it passes into the brew, and its flavor dilution factor rises from 32 in the ground coffee to 512 in the brew—it matters more in the cup than in the grounds.

zh.name: 糠醛
zh.odor: 杏仁膏、燕麦片、面包皮般的甜香，偏木质。
zh.thr: 约 3 mg/L（文献相差约 10 倍）
zh.coffee: 糖在烘焙中降解生成，阿拉比卡蔗糖多所以更多；烘焙温度越高、时间越长反而越少。粉中稀释因子很高，但在咖啡液里远低于阈值。

en.name: Furfural
en.odor: Sweet aroma like marzipan, oatmeal and bread crust, leaning woody.
en.coffee: Formed by sugar degradation during roasting; Arabica, with more sucrose, has more. Higher roasting temperatures and longer roasting times actually reduce it. Its flavor dilution factor in ground coffee is high, but in the brew it is far below threshold.

zh.name: 5-甲基糠醛
zh.odor: 淡淡的焦糖、苦杏仁甜香，比糠醛更“糖”。
zh.coffee: 糖降解产物，含量不低，但在咖啡液中远低于阈值；冷萃中略高于热冲。

en.name: 5-Methylfurfural
en.odor: Faint caramel and bitter-almond sweetness, more “sugary” than furfural.
en.coffee: A sugar-degradation product present in appreciable amounts, but far below threshold in the brew; slightly higher in cold brew than in hot brew.

zh.name: 2-乙酰基呋喃
zh.odor: 微弱的可可、烤面包、略带烟熏的甜香。
zh.coffee: 冷萃咖啡中含量最高的挥发物之一，但阈值很高，很难单独闻出。

en.name: 2-Acetylfuran
en.odor: Faint sweet aroma of cocoa and toasted bread, slightly smoky.
en.coffee: One of the most abundant volatiles in cold brew, but its threshold is high, so it is hard to pick out on its own.

zh.name: 糠醇
zh.odor: 单独闻偏焦苦、“烤过头”，也有人说像熟火腿；量大但气味弱。
zh.coffee: 烘焙咖啡里含量很高的呋喃类之一（每千克几十毫克），GC-O 中多被描述为不讨喜的烘烤味，构成背景里的苦香。

en.name: Furfuryl alcohol
en.odor: On its own it smells burnt-bitter and “over-roasted,” though some say it resembles cooked ham; abundant but weak-smelling.
en.coffee: One of the most abundant furans in roasted coffee (tens of milligrams per kilogram); in GC-O it is mostly described as an unpleasant roasty note, forming part of the bitter-roasty background.

zh.name: 2-乙酰基-1-吡咯啉
zh.odor: 香米饭、爆米花、斑兰叶那股饭香和爆米花香。
foods: 泰国香米等香米（主要香气）
zh.coffee: 在咖啡中证据不多：意式浓缩的鼻后嗅闻和一项烘焙豆研究中检出（FD 32）。它极不稳定，可能因此难以测到。

en.name: 2-Acetyl-1-pyrroline
en.odor: The cooked-rice and popcorn aroma of fragrant (jasmine/basmati-type) rice, popcorn and pandan leaf.
foods: Fragrant rice such as Thai jasmine rice (main odorant)
en.coffee: Little evidence in coffee: detected in the retronasal aroma of espresso and in one study of roasted beans (FD 32). It is highly unstable, which may be why it is hard to measure.

zh.name: 2-乙酰基四氢吡啶（互变异构体，又称 6-乙酰基-1,2,3,4-四氢吡啶）
zh.odor: 爆米花、烤面包皮、饼干般的焦香。
zh.coffee: 仅一项研究：危地马拉日晒烘焙豆中 FD 高达 2048（与 2-糠硫醇相同），描述为“烘烤、爆米花”，尚未定量确认。

en.name: 2-Acetyltetrahydropyridine (tautomers; also called 6-acetyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyridine)
en.odor: Roasty aroma like popcorn, bread crust and crackers.
en.coffee: Only one study: in roasted natural (sun-dried) Guatemalan beans it reached FD 2048 (the same as 2-furfurylthiol) and was described as “roasty, popcorn”; not yet confirmed by quantification.

zh.name: 2-乙酰基噻唑
zh.odor: 爆米花、烤坚果般的焦香。
zh.coffee: 一项研究在烘焙豆中以 FD 256 检出（“烘烤”）。由半胱氨酸参与的美拉德反应生成。

en.name: 2-Acetylthiazole
en.odor: Roasty aroma like popcorn and roasted nuts.
en.coffee: One study detected it in roasted beans at FD 256 (“roasty”). Formed by Maillard reactions involving cysteine.

zh.name: 2-乙酰基吡嗪
zh.odor: 爆米花、烤玉米、炒麦子的焦香。
zh.coffee: 研磨时释放；烘焙豆中稀释因子不高（FD 16），作用有限。

en.name: Acetylpyrazine
en.odor: Roasty aroma of popcorn, roasted corn and toasted wheat.
en.coffee: Released on grinding; its flavor dilution factor in roasted beans is low (FD 16), so its role is limited.

zh.name: 2-甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 淡淡的烤坚果、可可、焦烤味。
zh.thr: 2.3 mg/L（LSB 数据库；文献差异极大）
zh.coffee: 咖啡里含量最多的吡嗪之一，烘焙越深越多；但阈值高，单独贡献不大。

en.name: Methylpyrazine
en.odor: Faint roasted-nut, cocoa and roasty notes.
en.thr: 2.3 mg/L (LSB database; literature values vary enormously)
en.coffee: One of the most abundant pyrazines in coffee, increasing with roast degree; but its threshold is high, so on its own it contributes little.

zh.name: 2,5-二甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 炒花生、烤坚果、可可般的香。
zh.coffee: 各个烘焙度的 GC-O 中都能闻到“烘焙咖啡”味；罗布斯塔略高。

en.name: 2,5-Dimethylpyrazine
en.odor: Aroma like roasted peanuts, roasted nuts and cocoa.
en.coffee: Smelled as “roasted coffee” in GC-O at every roast degree; slightly higher in Robusta.

zh.name: 2,6-二甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 可可、烤坚果、烤肉般的香气。
zh.coffee: 研磨顶空中常见，罗布斯塔略高；单独作用小。

en.name: 2,6-Dimethylpyrazine
en.odor: Aroma like cocoa, roasted nuts and roast meat.
en.coffee: Common in the headspace released on grinding; slightly higher in Robusta. Little effect on its own.

zh.name: 2-乙基-5-甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 烤坚果、带咖啡感的烘烤香。
zh.coffee: 烘焙豆中 FD 128（“烘烤、坚果”）；越南罗布斯塔高于印尼罗布斯塔。

en.name: 2-Ethyl-5-methylpyrazine
en.odor: Roasted-nut, coffee-like roasty aroma.
en.coffee: FD 128 in roasted beans (“roasty, nutty”); higher in Vietnamese than in Indonesian Robusta.

zh.name: 5-甲基-6,7-二氢-5H-环戊并吡嗪
zh.odor: 坚果、烤花生般的烘烤甜香。
zh.coffee: CharmAnalysis 中是咖啡液的重要香气之一（标准化值 22），研磨顶空中“坚果-烘烤”贡献大。

en.name: 5-Methyl-6,7-dihydro-5H-cyclopentapyrazine
en.odor: Sweet roasty aroma like nuts and roasted peanuts.
en.coffee: One of the important odorants of the brew by CharmAnalysis (normalized value 22); a major “nutty-roasty” contributor in the headspace released on grinding.

zh.name: 2-乙基-3,5-二甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 像薯片、炒坚果的焦香，带泥土气。
foods: 可可粉（最强香气之一，“薯片味”）
zh.coffee: 烘焙阿拉比卡中 OAV 约 160；缺省实验证明“烷基吡嗪”不可缺少。研磨时大量释放。注意别和 2-乙基-3,6-二甲基吡嗪混淆，后者阈值高约 100 倍。

en.name: 2-Ethyl-3,5-dimethylpyrazine
en.odor: Roasty aroma like potato chips and roasted nuts, with an earthy edge.
foods: Cocoa powder (one of the most potent odorants; “potato chip” note)
en.coffee: OAV about 160 in roasted Arabica; omission tests showed that the “alkylpyrazines” are indispensable. Released in large amounts on grinding. Do not confuse it with 2-ethyl-3,6-dimethylpyrazine, whose threshold is about 100 times higher.

zh.name: 2,3-二乙基-5-甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 带泥土、霉土气的烤坚果香。
zh.coffee: 烘焙阿拉比卡中 OAV 约 95，是只用 9 种物质就能大致还原咖啡香的“简化模型”成员之一；蒸汽处理会减少它。

en.name: 2,3-Diethyl-5-methylpyrazine
en.odor: Roasted-nut aroma with earthy, musty-soil notes.
foods: Raw hazelnuts (one of the key odorants)
en.coffee: OAV about 95 in roasted Arabica; one of the members of the “simplified model” that roughly recreates coffee aroma with just 9 compounds. Steam treatment reduces it.

zh.name: 2-乙基-3,6-二甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 烤榛子、爆米花般的坚果烘烤香，略带泥土气。
zh.coffee: 一项研究中 FD 1024；另一项研究只在最浅的两个烘焙度中闻到它。

en.name: 2-Ethyl-3,6-dimethylpyrazine
en.odor: Nutty, roasty aroma like roasted hazelnuts and popcorn, slightly earthy.
en.coffee: FD 1024 in one study; another study smelled it only in the two lightest roasts.

zh.name: 2,3,5-三甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 可可、烤坚果、泥土般的烘烤香。
zh.coffee: 部分商业咖啡中 OAV > 1，CharmAnalysis 中也有一定贡献，但不在 Grosch 团队的关键香气之列。

en.name: Trimethylpyrazine
en.odor: Roasty aroma like cocoa, roasted nuts and earth.
foods: Chinese toon (Toona sinensis) shoots (one of the key odorants)
en.coffee: OAV > 1 in some commercial coffees, and it also contributes somewhat in CharmAnalysis, but it is not among the key odorants identified by Grosch’s group.

zh.name: 2-乙烯基-3,5-二甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 烤土豆皮、泥土般的烘烤香。
zh.coffee: 1996 年首次在咖啡中发现的强效泥土味吡嗪，在烘焙罗布斯塔中更突出；被纳入咖啡液的香气模型。

en.name: 2-Ethenyl-3,5-dimethylpyrazine
en.odor: Roasty aroma like roasted potato skin and earth.
en.coffee: A potent earthy pyrazine first found in coffee in 1996, more prominent in roasted Robusta; included in the aroma model of the brew.

zh.name: 2-乙烯基-3-乙基-5-甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 泥土气的烘烤香。
zh.coffee: 与上一个同时在烘焙罗布斯塔中发现，是罗布斯塔“土味”的来源之一。

en.name: 2-Ethenyl-3-ethyl-5-methylpyrazine
en.odor: Earthy, roasty aroma.
en.coffee: Discovered in roasted Robusta at the same time as 2-ethenyl-3,5-dimethylpyrazine; one of the sources of Robusta’s “earthy” note.

zh.name: 3-甲基丁醛
zh.odor: 典型的麦芽香，像麦片、可可粉，也带点杏仁和水果感。
zh.coffee: 亮氨酸的 Strecker 降解产物。缺省实验证实是影响最大的物质之一，咖啡液中 OAV 排前六。烘焙早期形成，烘焙加深后比例下降。

en.name: 3-Methylbutanal
en.odor: Classic malty aroma, like cereal and cocoa powder, with a hint of almond and fruit.
foods: Soy sauce (one of the key odorants)
en.coffee: Strecker degradation product of leucine. Omission tests confirmed it as one of the most influential compounds, and its OAV ranks in the top six in the brew. Forms early in roasting; its share falls as the roast gets darker.

zh.name: 2-甲基丁醛
zh.odor: 麦芽、可可粉般的香气，带一点发酵感。
zh.coffee: 异亮氨酸的 Strecker 降解产物；与 3-甲基丁醛一同被缺省实验证实重要，也是“简化模型”的成员。

en.name: 2-Methylbutanal
en.odor: Malty, cocoa-powder-like aroma with a slightly fermented touch.
foods: Soy sauce (one of the key odorants)
en.coffee: Strecker degradation product of isoleucine; confirmed as important by omission tests together with 3-methylbutanal, and also a member of the “simplified model.”

zh.name: 2-甲基丙醛
zh.odor: 麦芽般的甜香，带一点发酵水果感；挥发极快，是刚磨开的咖啡粉上方最先冲出来的香气之一。
zh.coffee: 缬氨酸的 Strecker 降解产物；缺省实验证实重要，咖啡液中 OAV 排前六。

en.name: 2-Methylpropanal
en.odor: Sweet malty aroma with a hint of fermented fruit. Extremely volatile, it is one of the first aromas to rush up from freshly ground coffee.
en.coffee: Strecker degradation product of valine; confirmed as important by omission tests, and its OAV ranks in the top six in the brew.

zh.name: 愈创木酚（2-甲氧基苯酚）
zh.odor: 典型的烟熏味：像烟熏腊肉、火腿、柴火烟，带一点药味（正露丸那种）。
foods: 柴火烟熏风味（最强香气之一）
正露丸（木馏油的主要成分）
zh.coffee: 绿原酸降解的产物：豆温升高后由 4-乙烯基愈创木酚氧化而来。缺省实验证实重要；罗布斯塔约为阿拉比卡的 7 倍，烘焙越深越多。

en.name: Guaiacol (2-methoxyphenol)
en.odor: The classic smoky note: like smoked Chinese cured bacon, ham and wood smoke, with a slightly medicinal touch (like Seirogan, a Japanese wood-creosote stomach remedy).
foods: Wood-smoke flavor (one of the most potent odorants)
Seirogan pills (a main component of their wood creosote)
en.coffee: A breakdown product of chlorogenic acid: it forms from 4-vinylguaiacol by oxidation as bean temperature rises. Omission tests confirmed its importance; Robusta has about 7 times as much as Arabica, and levels rise with darker roasts.

zh.name: 4-乙基愈创木酚
zh.odor: 像烟熏火腿、丁香和酱油那种烟熏辛香。
foods: 酱油（烟熏香的主要来源之一）
zh.coffee: 罗布斯塔“粗、烟熏、土味”的主要来源之一，含量约为阿拉比卡的 11 倍；烘焙中增加，只有约一半进入咖啡液。在葡萄酒里它是酒香酵母（Brett）污染的标志之一。

en.name: 4-Ethylguaiacol
en.odor: Smoky-spicy aroma like smoked ham, cloves and soy sauce.
foods: Soy sauce (one of the main sources of its smoky aroma)
en.coffee: One of the main sources of Robusta’s “harsh, smoky, earthy” character, at about 11 times the Arabica level; it increases during roasting, and only about half ends up in the brew. In wine it is one of the markers of Brettanomyces (“Brett”) yeast contamination.

zh.name: 4-甲基愈创木酚
zh.odor: 介于香草和丁香之间的烟熏甜香，带皮革感。
foods: 柴火烟熏风味（重要香气之一）
zh.coffee: 胶囊浓缩中普遍检出；在咖啡中缺少嗅闻和 OAV 数据，作用不明。

en.name: 4-Methylguaiacol
en.odor: Sweet smoky aroma somewhere between vanilla and clove, with a leathery touch.
foods: Wood-smoke flavor (one of the important odorants)
en.coffee: Commonly detected in capsule espresso; olfactometry and OAV data for coffee are lacking, so its role is unclear.

zh.name: 2-甲氧基-5-乙烯基苯酚
zh.odor: 强烈的烟熏味。
zh.coffee: 新鲜生豆中没有，只在温湿条件下储存后出现（40 °C、含水 13.5% 存 9 个月达 250 µg/kg），和 4-乙烯基愈创木酚一起让陈豆带烟熏、丁香味，可作为生豆储存不当的指标。

en.name: 2-Methoxy-5-vinylphenol
en.odor: Intensely smoky.
en.coffee: Absent from fresh green beans; it appears only after storage under warm, humid conditions (250 µg/kg after 9 months at 40 °C and 13.5% moisture). Together with 4-vinylguaiacol it gives aged (stored) beans a smoky, clove-like note, and it can serve as an indicator of poor green-bean storage.

zh.name: 4-乙烯基愈创木酚
zh.odor: 丁香般的辛香加一点烟熏——和德式小麦啤酒（白啤）里那股“丁香味”是同一个分子。
foods: 德式小麦啤酒（丁香味的来源）
zh.coffee: 由 5-阿魏酰奎宁酸先水解、阿魏酸再脱羧生成，烘焙早期就出现；罗布斯塔约为阿拉比卡的 3 倍；缺省实验证实重要，但只有约 30% 进入咖啡液。丁香油里的丁香酚在咖啡中并不重要，咖啡的“丁香感”主要来自它。

en.name: 4-Vinylguaiacol
en.odor: Clove-like spice with a touch of smoke—the same molecule behind the “clove” note of German wheat beer (Weissbier).
foods: German wheat beer (source of its clove note)
en.coffee: Formed when 5-feruloylquinic acid is hydrolyzed and the released ferulic acid is then decarboxylated; it appears early in roasting. Robusta has about 3 times as much as Arabica. Omission tests confirmed its importance, but only about 30% passes into the brew. Eugenol, the compound in clove oil, is not important in coffee; coffee’s “clove” note comes mainly from 4-vinylguaiacol.

zh.name: 苯酚
zh.odor: 墨水、药水、消毒水般的酚味。
zh.coffee: 由愈创木酚在更高的豆温下进一步转化而来；咖啡液中远低于阈值。

en.name: Phenol
en.odor: Phenolic smell like ink, medicine and disinfectant.
en.coffee: Formed by further conversion of guaiacol at higher bean temperatures; far below threshold in the brew.

zh.name: 间甲酚（3-甲基苯酚）
zh.odor: 烟熏、药水、皮革感的酚味；来苏水（煤酚皂）的气味就来自甲酚类。
zh.coffee: 意式浓缩的嗅闻中描述为“烟熏”；咖啡液中浓度接近阈值。

en.name: m-Cresol (3-methylphenol)
en.odor: Smoky, medicinal, leathery phenolic smell; the odor of Lysol-type cresol disinfectant (saponated cresol solution) comes from cresols.
en.coffee: Described as “smoky” in olfactometry of espresso; its concentration in the brew is close to threshold.

zh.name: 对甲酚（4-甲基苯酚）
zh.odor: 马厩、猪圈那种粪臭夹着酚味；在意式浓缩中则被描述为烟熏味。
zh.coffee: 一项研究在烘焙豆中以 FD 256 检出（“粪臭、马厩、尿味”），未定量。

en.name: p-Cresol (4-methylphenol)
en.odor: The fecal stench of horse stables and pigsties, mixed with a phenolic note; in espresso, however, it has been described as smoky.
en.coffee: One study detected it in roasted beans at FD 256 (“fecal, horse stable, urine”); not quantified.

zh.name: 3-乙基苯酚
zh.odor: 皮革、墨水般的酚味，带烟灰感。
zh.coffee: 烘焙豆中 FD 512（“酚、皮革”）；热冲咖啡中约 17 µg/L，OAV 约 10。也是柴火烟中最强的香气之一（“烟灰”）。

en.name: 3-Ethylphenol
en.odor: Leathery, inky phenolic smell with an ashy note.
en.coffee: FD 512 in roasted beans (“phenolic, leathery”); about 17 µg/L in hot-brewed coffee, OAV about 10. Also one of the most potent odorants in wood smoke (“ashy”).

zh.name: 吡啶
zh.odor: 刺鼻的鱼腥、氨水味；很稀时带烟熏焦糊感。
zh.coffee: 由葫芦巴碱在烘焙中热解生成，烘焙越深越多（云南冷萃深烘约为浅烘的 6 倍），过度烘焙时仍在增加；但在嗅闻中几乎闻不出来。

en.name: Pyridine
en.odor: Pungent fishy, ammonia-like smell; smoky and burnt when very dilute.
en.coffee: Formed by pyrolysis of trigonelline during roasting and increases with roast degree (about 6 times higher in dark- than in light-roast Yunnan cold brew), still rising during over-roasting; yet it is barely detectable in olfactometry.

zh.name: 2-糠基硫醇（2-糠硫醇）
zh.alt: GB 2760 中又名“咖啡醛”，实为硫醇
zh.odor: 极稀时就是刚冲好的咖啡那股焦香；浓了是刺鼻的硫磺、焦糊味。和刚炒好的白芝麻香非常像。
zh.coffee: 糠醛与半胱氨酸放出的硫化氢在烘焙中反应生成，越烘越多。粉和咖啡液的缺省实验都证实它是核心香气。冲好的咖啡放置时，它会被黑色素结合而迅速减少，是“不新鲜”的主要原因之一。

en.name: 2-Furfurylthiol
en.odor: When very dilute, it is the roasty aroma of freshly brewed coffee; concentrated, it is a pungent sulfurous, burnt smell. Very similar to freshly toasted white sesame.
foods: Toasted sesame (one of the most potent odorants)
en.coffee: Formed during roasting when furfural reacts with hydrogen sulfide released from cysteine; increases with roast degree. Omission tests on both ground coffee and the brew confirmed it as a core odorant. When brewed coffee stands, it is rapidly bound by melanoidins (brown roast pigments) and lost—one of the main reasons coffee loses its freshness.

zh.name: 糠基甲基硫醚
zh.odor: 像生洋葱、大蒜的辛辣硫味，稀释后带烘烤、烟熏感。
zh.coffee: 研磨顶空和意式浓缩中常见（“烟熏烘烤”）；云南冷萃深烘约为浅烘的 14 倍。

en.name: Furfuryl methyl sulfide
en.odor: Pungent sulfurous smell like raw onion and garlic; roasty and smoky when diluted.
en.coffee: Common in the headspace released on grinding and in espresso (“smoky, roasty”); about 14 times higher in dark- than in light-roast Yunnan cold brew.

zh.name: 3-巯基-3-甲基丁基甲酸酯
zh.odor: 纯品是带腥气的猫尿、黑醋栗硫味；极稀释在咖啡里，就成了“烘焙咖啡感”的一部分。
foods: 浅色拉格啤酒（主要香气之一）
zh.coffee: 由生豆里的异戊烯醇与硫化氢、甲酸在烘焙中生成，越烘越多，高温短时烘焙更多。缺省实验证实它在咖啡液中比在粉里更重要。咖啡的“猫尿 / 黑醋栗”印象来自它，而不是常被提到的 4-巯基-4-甲基-2-戊酮（后者在咖啡中未见报道）。

en.name: 3-Mercapto-3-methylbutyl formate
en.odor: Pure, it has a rank, sulfurous smell of cat urine (catty note) and blackcurrant; highly diluted in coffee, it becomes part of the “roasted coffee” character.
foods: Pale lager beer (one of the main odorants)
en.coffee: Formed during roasting from prenyl alcohol in green beans with hydrogen sulfide and formic acid; increases with roast degree, and more forms in high-temperature, short-time roasting. Omission tests confirmed that it matters more in the brew than in ground coffee. Coffee’s “cat urine / blackcurrant” impression comes from this compound, not from the often-cited 4-mercapto-4-methyl-2-pentanone (which has not been reported in coffee).

zh.name: 3-巯基-3-甲基丁基乙酸酯
zh.odor: 深烘咖啡里浓重的焦烤硫香。
zh.coffee: 2003 年首次在咖啡中发现；浅中烘时几乎不增加，深烘时急剧升高，是深烘咖啡的重要香气。在加热灭菌的罐装咖啡中比甲酸酯稳定。

en.name: 3-Mercapto-3-methylbutyl acetate
en.odor: The heavy, roasty sulfur note of dark-roast coffee.
en.coffee: First found in coffee in 2003; it barely increases in light and medium roasts but rises sharply in dark roasts, making it an important odorant of dark-roast coffee. In heat-sterilized canned coffee it is more stable than the corresponding formate.

zh.name: 2-甲基-3-呋喃硫醇
zh.odor: 典型的炖牛肉、肉汤香，极低浓度就能闻到；浓了是刺鼻的硫醇味。
foods: 煮牛肉、牛肉汤（高香气值物质）
zh.coffee: 核糖与半胱氨酸的美拉德产物。咖啡液 CharmAnalysis 中仅次于 2-糠硫醇，但缺省实验中去掉它影响不大。在溶液里很快被氧化成二硫醚。

en.name: 2-Methyl-3-furanthiol
en.odor: The classic aroma of stewed beef and meat broth, detectable at extremely low concentrations; concentrated, a pungent thiol smell.
en.coffee: A Maillard product of ribose and cysteine. Second only to 2-furfurylthiol in CharmAnalysis of the brew, yet removing it in omission tests made little difference. In solution it is quickly oxidized to its disulfide.

zh.name: 双(2-甲基-3-呋喃基)二硫醚
zh.odor: 像红烧肉、炖肉那种浓郁肉香，带一点甜。
zh.coffee: 2-甲基-3-呋喃硫醇氧化后的二聚体；在阿拉比卡粉和咖啡液中以“肉香、甜”检出，未定量。

en.name: Bis(2-methyl-3-furyl) disulfide
en.odor: Rich meaty aroma like red-braised pork (Chinese soy-braised pork belly) and stewed meat, slightly sweet.
en.coffee: The oxidized dimer of 2-methyl-3-furanthiol; detected as “meaty, sweet” in ground Arabica and its brew; not quantified.

zh.name: 3-巯基-3-甲基-1-丁醇
zh.odor: 像肉汤、炒洋葱的咸鲜硫味，偶带汗味。
zh.coffee: 含量比它的甲酸酯、乙酸酯都多，但阈值高得多，单独贡献有限；烘焙越深越多，罐装咖啡加热时也会由酯水解产生。

en.name: 3-Mercapto-3-methylbutan-1-ol
en.odor: Savory sulfurous smell like meat broth and fried onions, occasionally sweaty.
en.coffee: More abundant than its formate and acetate esters, but with a much higher threshold, so its own contribution is limited. Increases with roast degree; also forms by hydrolysis of the esters when canned coffee is heated.

zh.name: 2-乙酰基-2-噻唑啉
zh.odor: 烤肉、烤面包皮式的焦香。
foods: 烤牛肉（特征香气研究中的定量物质）
zh.coffee: 烘焙豆中 FD 256（“油脂、烘烤”），意式浓缩中也有；没有定量数据。

en.name: 2-Acetyl-2-thiazoline
en.odor: Roasty aroma of roast meat and bread crust.
foods: Roast beef (quantified in studies of its characteristic aroma)
en.coffee: FD 256 in roasted beans (“fatty, roasty”); also present in espresso. No quantitative data.

zh.name: 3-甲硫基丙醛
zh.odor: 煮土豆、薯片那种土豆香，同时带酱油般的咸鲜感。
zh.coffee: 蛋氨酸的 Strecker 降解产物，生豆中已有，烘焙中大幅增加；缺省实验证实是咖啡液的核心香气之一（在液中比在粉里更重要）。中烘到深烘时可能下降。

en.name: Methional
en.odor: Potato aroma like boiled potatoes and potato chips, with a savory, soy-sauce-like note.
en.coffee: Strecker degradation product of methionine; already present in green beans and greatly increased by roasting. Omission tests confirmed it as one of the core odorants of the brew (more important in the brew than in ground coffee). May decline from medium to dark roast.

zh.name: 二甲基硫醚
zh.odor: 稀时像罐头玉米、海苔那种鲜甜的硫味；浓了像煮芦笋、烂菜叶。
zh.coffee: 烘焙咖啡顶空中检出；储存时甲硫醇减少，而二甲基硫醚增多。不是关键香气。

en.name: Dimethyl sulfide
en.odor: Dilute, a sweet, savory sulfur note like canned corn and nori seaweed; concentrated, like cooked asparagus and rotting greens.
foods: Jingshan tea (a Chinese green tea; one of the key odorants)
en.coffee: Detected in the headspace of roasted coffee; during storage methanethiol decreases while dimethyl sulfide increases. Not a key odorant.

zh.name: 甲硫醇
zh.odor: 单独闻是烂白菜、臭鸡蛋样的硫臭；混在刚磨开的咖啡粉香里，却是“新鲜感”的来源之一。
zh.coffee: 咖啡中含量最高的硫醇，由蛋氨酸热解生成。咖啡液中 OAV 排前六，是新鲜度的指标：整豆放置 1 天就明显减少，8 天剩约 30%，3 周剩 10–20%。

en.name: Methanethiol
en.odor: On its own, a sulfurous stench of rotten cabbage and rotten eggs; blended into the aroma of freshly ground coffee, it is one source of the “fresh” impression.
en.coffee: The most abundant thiol in coffee, formed by thermal breakdown of methionine. Its OAV ranks in the top six in the brew, and it is a freshness indicator: in whole beans it drops noticeably after 1 day, to about 30% after 8 days and 10–20% after 3 weeks.

zh.name: 二甲基二硫醚
zh.odor: 像煮过头的卷心菜、洋葱的硫磺味。
zh.coffee: 储存中甲硫醇被氧化而生成；哥伦比亚咖啡中较高；深烘冷萃中更多。

en.name: Dimethyl disulfide
en.odor: Sulfurous smell like overcooked cabbage and onion.
en.coffee: Formed by oxidation of methanethiol during storage; relatively high in Colombian coffee; more abundant in dark-roast cold brew.

zh.name: 二甲基三硫醚
zh.odor: 像煮久了的白菜、卷心菜那股闷闷的硫味；阈值极低。
zh.coffee: 烘焙豆中 FD 128（“辛、卷心菜、硫”）；是过度烘焙时仍持续增加的少数物质之一。

en.name: Dimethyl trisulfide
en.odor: The dull, stuffy sulfur smell of long-cooked napa cabbage and green cabbage; extremely low threshold.
foods: Cocoa powder (one of the most potent odorants)
en.coffee: FD 128 in roasted beans (“pungent, cabbage, sulfurous”); one of the few compounds that keeps increasing during over-roasting.

zh.name: 3-甲基-2-丁烯-1-硫醇
zh.odor: 就是啤酒晒太阳后的“日光臭”、臭鼬味；在咖啡里量极微，表现为烟熏、焦烤般的硫香。
foods: 见光变质的啤酒（日光臭的成因）
zh.coffee: 由生豆里的异戊烯醇与硫化氢在烘焙中生成，越烘越多；新鲜烘焙咖啡的顶空里带“狐臭、臭鼬”般的新鲜感，研磨时贡献“烟熏烘烤”。缺省实验中去掉它影响不大。

en.name: 3-Methyl-2-butene-1-thiol
en.odor: The “lightstruck,” skunky smell of beer left in the sun; in coffee, at trace levels, it comes across as a smoky, roasty sulfur note.
foods: Lightstruck beer (cause of the skunky off-flavor)
en.coffee: Formed during roasting from prenyl alcohol in green beans and hydrogen sulfide; increases with roast degree. In the headspace of freshly roasted coffee it gives a “foxy, skunky” freshness, and on grinding it contributes a “smoky, roasty” note. Removing it in omission tests made little difference.

zh.name: 土臭素
zh.odor: 雨后泥土、刚挖出的红菜头（甜菜根）那股土味。
foods: 饮用水、淡水鱼的土腥异味
zh.coffee: 放线菌等微生物产生的污染物。发霉 / 泥土缺陷的墨西哥生豆中约为正常豆的 8 倍；推测与干法后处理有关，水洗的肯尼亚、哥伦比亚豆中没有发现这种缺陷。

en.name: Geosmin
en.odor: The earthy smell of soil after rain and freshly dug beets.
foods: Earthy, muddy off-flavor of drinking water and freshwater fish
en.coffee: A contaminant produced by actinomycetes and other microbes. About 8 times higher in Mexican green beans with a moldy/earthy defect than in normal beans; presumably linked to dry processing, as the defect was not found in washed Kenyan or Colombian beans.

zh.name: 2-甲氧基-3,5-二甲基吡嗪
zh.odor: 潮湿泥土和发霉软木塞的土霉气；葡萄酒“木塞味”的成因之一。
zh.coffee: 生阿拉比卡中 OAV 第二高的香气物质；烘焙咖啡中未见报道。

en.name: 2-Methoxy-3,5-dimethylpyrazine
en.odor: Earthy, musty smell of damp soil and moldy cork; one cause of “corked” wine.
en.coffee: The odorant with the second-highest OAV in green Arabica; not reported in roasted coffee.

zh.name: 2-甲基异莰醇
zh.odor: 像自来水、池塘水的“土霉味”，潮湿地下室的霉土气。
foods: 饮用水的土霉味（国标限值 10 ng/L）
zh.coffee: 罗布斯塔中含量明显高于阿拉比卡，曾被认为是罗布斯塔“土味”的来源；但感官实验表明它只带来霉味，并造不出罗布斯塔的特征。在阿拉比卡中属于污染。

en.name: 2-Methylisoborneol
en.odor: The “earthy-musty” taint of tap water and pond water; the moldy-earth smell of a damp basement.
foods: Earthy-musty taint in drinking water (China’s national standard limit: 10 ng/L)
en.coffee: Markedly higher in Robusta than in Arabica, and once thought to be the source of Robusta’s “earthy” note; but sensory experiments showed that it only adds mustiness and cannot recreate Robusta’s character. In Arabica it counts as a contaminant.

zh.name: 2,4,6-三氯苯甲醚
zh.odor: 葡萄酒“木塞味”的元凶：像受潮发霉的纸箱、地窖、旧报纸；在咖啡里常被形容为“碘酒、药水味”，即巴西的“Rio 味”。
foods: 葡萄酒木塞污染（主要成因）
zh.coffee: 巴西 Rio 缺陷的关键物质，由霉菌把 2,4,6-三氯苯酚甲基化而成；多在湿润天气采收时出现，烘焙只能去掉不到一半。

en.name: 2,4,6-Trichloroanisole (TCA)
en.odor: The culprit behind “corked” wine: like damp, moldy cardboard, cellars and old newspapers. In coffee it is often described as “iodine-like, medicinal”—the Brazilian “Rioy” taint.
en.coffee: The key compound of the Brazilian Rioy defect, formed when molds methylate 2,4,6-trichlorophenol; it mostly occurs when the harvest meets humid weather, and roasting removes less than half of it.

zh.name: 2,4,6-三氯苯酚
zh.odor: 像消毒水、药皂一类的酚类药味，远不如三氯苯甲醚灵敏。
zh.coffee: 多数 Rio 生豆中都有，是三氯苯甲醚的前体；本身不太闻得出来。

en.name: 2,4,6-Trichlorophenol
en.odor: Phenolic, medicinal smell like disinfectant and medicated soap; far less potent than trichloroanisole.
en.coffee: Present in most Rioy green beans and the precursor of trichloroanisole (TCA); hard to smell on its own.

zh.name: 2,6-二氯苯酚
zh.odor: 碘酒般的“氯味、药味”。
zh.coffee: 2011 年新确认的 Rio 味成分：轻度 Rio 豆中 0.8 µg/kg、重度 3.0 µg/kg，正常豆低于 0.1；与三氯苯甲醚协同加重异味。

en.name: 2,6-Dichlorophenol
en.odor: Iodine-like, “chlorinous, medicinal” smell.
en.coffee: A Rioy-taint component newly identified in 2011: 0.8 µg/kg in mildly Rioy beans and 3.0 µg/kg in strongly Rioy beans, versus below 0.1 in normal beans; it acts synergistically with trichloroanisole to intensify the off-flavor.

zh.name: 2-异丙基-3-甲氧基吡嗪
zh.odor: 像刚削皮的生土豆、生豌豆和豆角的青土气；浓时就是“生土豆皮 + 泥土”味。
zh.coffee: 正常咖啡里也有微量（烘焙粉中是强香气物质），但在卢旺达、布隆迪等东非咖啡的“土豆味缺陷”中大幅升高，与 Antestia 蝽虫叮咬有关。专业杯测师在咖啡里约 110 ng/L 就能察觉。

en.name: 2-Isopropyl-3-methoxypyrazine (IPMP)
en.odor: Green, earthy smell like freshly peeled raw potato, raw peas and string beans; when strong, it is a “raw potato peel + soil” smell.
en.coffee: Present in trace amounts in normal coffee (a potent odorant in roasted ground coffee), but sharply elevated in the potato taste defect (PTD) of East African coffees such as those from Rwanda and Burundi, which is linked to feeding by Antestia bugs. Professional cuppers can detect it in coffee at about 110 ng/L.

zh.name: 1-辛烯-3-酮
zh.odor: 像生蘑菇；稀释后很像握过铁栏杆、数过硬币后手上那股“金属味”。
foods: 蘑菇（双孢菇等的关键香气）
zh.coffee: 在烘焙粉和咖啡液的顶空嗅闻中检出（“蘑菇样”），未进入重组模型。

en.name: 1-Octen-3-one
en.odor: Like raw mushrooms; diluted, it closely resembles the “metallic” smell left on your hands after gripping an iron railing or counting coins.
foods: Mushrooms (key odorant of button mushrooms and others)
en.coffee: Detected by headspace olfactometry of roasted ground coffee and the brew (“mushroom-like”); not included in the recombination model.

zh.name: 1-辛烯-3-醇
zh.odor: 新鲜蘑菇的味道，带一点潮湿泥土气。
zh.coffee: 只在生豆中检出（墨西哥生豆中“蘑菇样”）；它对应的酮（1-辛烯-3-酮）灵敏约 3000 倍。

en.name: 1-Octen-3-ol
en.odor: The smell of fresh mushrooms, with a hint of damp earth.
en.coffee: Detected only in green beans (“mushroom-like” in Mexican green beans); its corresponding ketone, 1-octen-3-one, is about 3000 times more potent.

zh.name: 吲哚
zh.odor: 浓时是樟脑丸、粪臭般的动物气；极淡时成了茉莉花香的“底子”。
foods: 茉莉花茶（特征香气之一）
zh.coffee: 生熟豆中都有痕量；烘焙不足（“过浅”缺陷）的咖啡中偏高，被选为这种缺陷的标志物。

en.name: Indole
en.odor: Concentrated, an animalic smell of mothballs and feces; extremely dilute, it becomes the underlying base of jasmine scent.
foods: Jasmine tea (one of the character odorants)
en.coffee: Present in trace amounts in both green and roasted beans; elevated in under-roasted coffee (the “too light” defect) and chosen as a marker of that defect.

zh.name: 3-甲基吲哚
zh.odor: 樟脑丸混着粪臭的动物性气味。
zh.coffee: 在过滤咖啡和意式浓缩中以痕量检出（“樟脑丸、粪臭”）。2025 年的同位素标记实验证明，它在烘焙中由色氨酸经吲哚乙酸生成。

en.name: Skatole (3-methylindole)
en.odor: Animalic smell of mothballs mixed with feces.
en.coffee: Detected in trace amounts in filter coffee and espresso (“mothball, fecal”). Isotope-labeling experiments in 2025 showed that it forms during roasting from tryptophan via indoleacetic acid.

zh.name: 2-异丁基-3-甲氧基吡嗪
zh.odor: 像刚切开的青椒（灯笼椒）的青辣气，夹着豌豆荚和一点泥土味；生豆那股“豆荚 / 生豆”气主要来自它。
zh.coffee: 生阿拉比卡中 OAV 最高的香气物质；烘焙不会让它减少，在烘焙豆中仍是强香气（FD 4096）。在其他香气还没发展起来的浅烘里，“豆荚味”更容易露出来（推测）。

en.name: 2-Isobutyl-3-methoxypyrazine (IBMP)
en.odor: The sharp green smell of freshly cut green bell pepper, mixed with pea pod and a little earthiness; the “pea-pod / raw-bean” smell of green coffee comes mainly from it.
foods: Green and sweet bell peppers (important odorant)
en.coffee: The odorant with the highest OAV in green Arabica; roasting does not reduce it, and it remains a potent odorant in roasted beans (FD 4096). In light roasts, where other aromas have not yet developed, the “pea-pod” note shows through more easily (speculative).

zh.name: 2-仲丁基-3-甲氧基吡嗪
zh.odor: 与异丁基甲氧基吡嗪很像：青椒、生豌豆荚的青土气，带一点胡萝卜皮感。
zh.coffee: 2001 年才首次在咖啡（墨西哥生豆）中发现；对发霉 / 泥土缺陷的贡献较小。

en.name: 2-sec-Butyl-3-methoxypyrazine
en.odor: Very similar to isobutylmethoxypyrazine: the green, earthy smell of green bell pepper and raw pea pods, with a hint of carrot peel.
en.coffee: Not found in coffee until 2001 (in Mexican green beans); contributes little to the moldy/earthy defect.

zh.name: (E,Z)-2,6-壬二烯醛
zh.odor: 就是黄瓜（尤其是黄瓜皮）的清香。
zh.coffee: 生豆嗅闻中“黄瓜样”很强；烘焙咖啡中未见报道。

en.name: (E,Z)-2,6-Nonadienal
en.odor: The fresh smell of cucumber itself, especially cucumber peel.
en.coffee: Strongly “cucumber-like” in olfactometry of green beans; not reported in roasted coffee.

zh.name: 己醛
zh.odor: 像刚割的青草、生黄豆的青腥气；浓了或放久了带油脂的“哈喇味”。
zh.coffee: 亚油酸氧化的产物。生豆中带青草味；烘焙咖啡在空气中储存数周后开始增多，是常用的陈化指标，但解释不了早期的不新鲜。

en.name: Hexanal
en.odor: Green, beany smell like fresh-cut grass and raw soybeans; when concentrated or old, a fatty, “rancid” note.
en.coffee: A product of linoleic acid oxidation. Grassy in green beans; in roasted coffee stored in air it begins to increase after several weeks and is a common staling indicator, but it cannot explain the early loss of freshness.

zh.name: (E)-2-壬烯醛
zh.odor: 典型的“纸板味”：像受潮的旧纸箱、放久变味的啤酒，带黄瓜皮似的青油气。
foods: 陈化啤酒（纸板味的主要来源）
zh.coffee: 烘焙粉和咖啡液嗅闻中都有（“油脂”），烘焙豆中 FD 256，但不在 Grosch 的重组模型里；生豆储存时略有增加。

en.name: (E)-2-Nonenal
en.odor: The classic “cardboard” smell: like damp old cardboard boxes and stale beer, with a green, fatty note like cucumber peel.
foods: Aged beer (main source of the cardboard off-flavor)
en.coffee: Found by olfactometry in both roasted ground coffee and the brew (“fatty”), and at FD 256 in roasted beans, but not part of Grosch’s recombination model; increases slightly during green-bean storage.

zh.name: (Z)-2-壬烯醛
zh.odor: 金属、牛油般的油脂味。
zh.coffee: CharmAnalysis 中被列为咖啡液的强香气之一（标准化值 27）；生豆嗅闻中“金属、牛油味”很强。

en.name: (Z)-2-Nonenal
en.odor: Metallic, tallowy fatty smell.
en.coffee: Listed by CharmAnalysis as one of the potent odorants of the brew (normalized value 27); strongly “metallic, tallowy” in olfactometry of green beans.

zh.name: (E,E)-2,4-癸二烯醛
zh.odor: 典型的油炸香：像刚出锅的炸薯条、油条外皮；氧化久了就是油哈喇味。
zh.coffee: 烘焙豆中 FD 1024；在生豆中则与“花生味”异味有关。不在 Grosch 的关键香气模型里。

en.name: (E,E)-2,4-Decadienal
en.odor: The classic deep-fried aroma: like French fries straight from the fryer or the crust of youtiao (Chinese fried dough sticks); after long oxidation, rancid oil.
en.coffee: FD 1024 in roasted beans; in green beans it is associated with a “peanut” off-flavor. Not in Grosch’s key-odorant model.

zh.name: (E,E)-2,4-壬二烯醛
zh.odor: 带青气的油脂氧化味，像放久的炒菜油。
zh.coffee: 生豆中的次要香气（FD 32），储存后反而减少。

en.name: (E,E)-2,4-Nonadienal
en.odor: Green, oxidized-fat smell, like cooking oil that has been kept too long.
en.coffee: A minor odorant in green beans (FD 32) that actually decreases with storage.

zh.name: 2-戊基呋喃
zh.odor: 像生豆子、豆浆的“豆腥”青气，带一点黄油和煮蔬菜感。
zh.coffee: 常出现在咖啡挥发物清单里，但只在一支耶加雪菲中以最低的稀释因子（FD 1）闻到；作用很小。

en.name: 2-Pentylfuran
en.odor: Green, “beany” smell like raw beans and soy milk, with a hint of butter and cooked vegetables.
en.coffee: Often appears in lists of coffee volatiles, but was smelled in only one Yirgacheffe, at the lowest flavor dilution factor (FD 1); its role is minor.

zh.name: 柠檬酸
zh.odor: 干净、带柑橘感的酸味，略涩；不挥发，没有气味。WCR 感官词典用柠檬酸溶液作为“酸”这一基本味的参照。
zh.thr: 咖啡中察觉阈值 <0.16 g/L（加入咖啡中测定；Rune 2023）
zh.coffee: 法压咖啡中 0.23–0.60 g/L；在浅烘范围内烘得越深越少（均值 0.49→0.32 g/L）；巴西豆（0.49 g/L）高于玻利维亚（0.40）和肯尼亚（0.30），但每个产地只测了两个样品。在咖啡里做的阈值测试中，它是唯一含量明显高于察觉阈值的有机酸；可是按平均浓度加进咖啡后，专业品鉴者仍认不出加的是哪种酸（Rune 2023）。

en.name: Citric acid
en.odor: Clean sourness with a citrus note and slight astringency; non-volatile, odourless. The WCR Sensory Lexicon uses citric acid solutions as the reference for the basic taste Sour.
foods: Lemon, orange and other citrus fruit
en.thr: Detection threshold in coffee <0.16 g/L (spiked into brew; Rune 2023)
en.coffee: 0.23–0.60 g/L in French-press brews; within the light-roast range it falls as roasting proceeds (means 0.49 → 0.32 g/L). Brazilian coffees (0.49 g/L) were higher than Bolivian (0.40) and Kenyan (0.30), with only two samples per origin. It was the only organic acid clearly above its detection threshold in coffee, yet when spiked at average concentrations coffee experts could not identify which acid had been added (Rune 2023).

zh.name: 苹果酸
zh.odor: 尖锐、带果味的酸，略涩；不挥发，没有气味。
zh.thr: 咖啡中察觉阈值 0.20 g/L（加入咖啡中测定；Rune 2023）
zh.coffee: 法压咖啡中约 0.12–0.20 g/L（各烘焙度均值），随烘焙加深而减少；巴西豆略高于肯尼亚豆，但差异不显著。含量与察觉阈值相当或更低，单独很难尝出；按平均浓度加进咖啡后专业品鉴者也认不出（Rune 2023）。

en.name: Malic acid
en.odor: Sharp, somewhat fruity sourness with astringency; non-volatile, odourless.
en.thr: Detection threshold in coffee 0.20 g/L (spiked into brew; Rune 2023)
en.coffee: About 0.12–0.20 g/L in French-press brews (roast-level means), decreasing with roast degree; Brazilian coffees slightly higher than Kenyan, not significantly. Its concentration is at or below the detection threshold, so it is unlikely to be tasted on its own, and experts could not identify it when it was spiked into coffee at average levels (Rune 2023).

zh.short: 绿原酸内酯（咖啡酰奎尼内酯）
zh.name: 绿原酸内酯（咖啡酰奎尼内酯）
zh.odor: 咖啡里典型的、比较圆润的苦味；不挥发。
zh.thr: 苦味识别阈值 9.8–180 µmol/L（水中，因结构而异；Frank 2006）；3-O-咖啡酰-epi-γ-奎尼内酯 58 µmol/L（Frank 2008）
zh.coffee: 烘焙时由绿原酸（咖啡酰 / 阿魏酰奎尼酸）失水内酯化生成。Frank 等用味觉稀释分析从咖啡液中鉴定出 10 种咖啡酰 / 阿魏酰奎尼内酯，可以解释去咖啡因咖啡约 80% 的苦味。主要在浅到中度烘焙时生成，烘得更深又会降解成苦味更“冲”的 4-乙烯基儿茶酚低聚物；单咖啡酰类冲煮时很快被萃出，双咖啡酰类较慢（Blumberg 2010）。

en.name: Chlorogenic acid lactones (caffeoyl quinides)
en.odor: The typical, rounded coffee bitterness; non-volatile.
en.thr: Bitter recognition thresholds 9.8–180 µmol/L in water, depending on structure (Frank 2006); 3-O-caffeoyl-epi-γ-quinide 58 µmol/L (Frank 2008)
en.coffee: Formed on roasting when chlorogenic acids (caffeoyl / feruloyl quinic acids) lose water and lactonise. Taste dilution analysis of coffee brew identified ten caffeoyl / feruloyl quinides that account for about 80% of the bitterness of a decaffeinated brew. They form mainly at light to medium roast and break down at darker roasts into the harsher 4-vinylcatechol oligomers; mono-caffeoyl quinides extract quickly, di-caffeoyl quinides more slowly (Blumberg 2010).

zh.short: 4-乙烯基儿茶酚低聚物（苯基茚满类）
zh.name: 4-乙烯基儿茶酚低聚物（苯基茚满类）
zh.odor: 尖锐、刺激的苦，像深烘意式浓缩那种苦；不挥发。
zh.thr: 苦味识别阈值 23–178 µmol/L（水中；Frank 2007）
zh.coffee: 烘焙时咖啡酸部分释放出 4-乙烯基儿茶酚，再聚合成 1,3-双(3,4-二羟基苯基)丁烷 / 丁烯和 8 种多羟基苯基茚满，共 10 种苦味物质，都已在咖啡液中检出（Frank 2007）。烘焙越重越多，部分由绿原酸内酯进一步降解而来，对应深烘时苦味由“咖啡式”变得刺激；冲煮时与咖啡粉结合较牢，较难萃出（Blumberg 2010）。

en.name: 4-Vinylcatechol oligomers (phenylindanes)
en.odor: Harsh, lingering bitterness reminiscent of a strongly roasted espresso; non-volatile.
en.thr: Bitter recognition thresholds 23–178 µmol/L in water (Frank 2007)
en.coffee: Caffeic acid moieties release 4-vinylcatechol on roasting, which oligomerises to 1,3-bis(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)butane / butene and eight hydroxylated phenylindanes – ten bitter compounds, all detected in coffee brew (Frank 2007). They increase with roast severity, partly from degradation of the chlorogenic acid lactones, matching the shift to a harsh bitterness in dark roasts, and are strongly retained by the grounds during brewing (Blumberg 2010).

zh.name: 咖啡因
zh.odor: 典型的“药片”式苦味；无气味。WCR 感官词典用咖啡因溶液作为“苦”的参照。
zh.thr: 苦味察觉阈值 0.67 mmol/L（约 130 mg/L，水中；Gigl 2026 所引）
zh.coffee: 生豆中就有。四十多年前 Chen 估计它最多贡献咖啡苦味的 10–30%（Gigl 2026 引）。Gigl 等发现：去咖啡因的烘焙咖啡里加入 7.5 mmol/L 咖啡因（约为阈值 10 倍），苦味没有显著增加，到 12.5 mmol/L（咖啡中不会出现的浓度）才尝得出；咖啡中的高分子黑色素能和咖啡因结合，使其苦味降低约一半，而它与绿原酸形成的复合物对苦味没有影响。

en.name: Caffeine
en.odor: The classic 'pill-like' bitterness; odourless. The WCR Sensory Lexicon uses caffeine solutions as the reference for Bitter.
en.thr: Bitter detection threshold 0.67 mmol/L (≈130 mg/L) in water (as cited by Gigl 2026)
