en.coffee: Already present in the green bean. Chen's work over 40 years ago estimated that caffeine contributes at most 10–30% of coffee bitterness (cited by Gigl 2026). Gigl et al. found that adding 7.5 mmol/L caffeine (≈10× threshold) to a decaffeinated roasted brew did not significantly increase bitterness; only 12.5 mmol/L, a level not found in coffee, was detected. High-molecular-weight melanoidins bind caffeine and cut its bitterness by about half, whereas the caffeine–chlorogenate complex has no effect.

zh.name: 钾（钾离子）
zh.odor: 无气味，不挥发；作为离子影响味觉。
zh.thr: —（未找到咖啡中的咸味阈值数据）
zh.coffee: 易溶，研磨咖啡冲煮时 73–89% 进入咖啡液；各研究报道的咖啡液含钾约 37–154 mg/100 mL（Olechno 2021），折合约 10–40 mmol/L，与 WCR 词典“咸”的最低参照（0.15% 氯化钠，约 26 mmol/L）同一量级。它是咖啡里最可能带来咸感的成分，但没有找到证实这一点的感官研究，证据薄弱。

en.name: Potassium (K⁺)
en.odor: Odourless, non-volatile; acts on taste as an ion.
foods: Vegetables and fruit, especially dried fruit
en.coffee: Highly soluble: 73–89% passes from roast-and-ground coffee into the brew, and brews contain about 37–154 mg/100 mL (Olechno 2021), i.e. roughly 10–40 mmol/L – the same order as the lowest WCR Salty reference (0.15% NaCl, ≈26 mmol/L). It is the most plausible source of any saltiness in coffee, but no sensory study confirming this was found; the evidence is thin.

zh.name: 钠（钠离子）
zh.odor: 无气味，不挥发；氯化钠是“咸”的典型参照。
zh.thr: —（WCR 词典“咸”的最低参照为 0.15% 氯化钠，强度 1.5）
zh.coffee: 含量很低：滴滤 / 冲泡咖啡约 0.1–2.8 mg/100 mL，个别土耳其咖啡达 29 mg/100 mL；冲煮时只有 30–48% 进入咖啡液（Olechno 2021）。WCR 最低咸味参照含钠约 59 mg/100 mL，比普通咖啡高一到两个数量级，所以钠很难单独让咖啡尝起来咸；冲煮用水的钠也会进入咖啡。

en.name: Sodium (Na⁺)
en.odor: Odourless, non-volatile; sodium chloride is the standard reference for Salty.
en.coffee: Low: about 0.1–2.8 mg/100 mL in filter / infusion brews, up to 29 mg/100 mL in one Turkish-coffee study; only 30–48% is extracted (Olechno 2021). The lowest WCR Salty reference contains ≈59 mg Na/100 mL, one to two orders of magnitude more than ordinary brews, so sodium alone is unlikely to make coffee taste salty; sodium in the brewing water also ends up in the cup.

zh.name: (E)-肉桂醛
zh.odor: 肉桂般的辛甜香，也被描述为苹果、糖果香（Gantner 2024）。
zh.coffee: 几项研究用顶空 GC-MS 在咖啡中检出：烘焙阿拉比卡和阿拉比卡 / 罗布斯塔拼配中峰面积占比 0.35–0.95%，纯罗布斯塔中没有（Gantner 2024，电子鼻快速 GC，按保留指数鉴定）；另有研究在烘焙阿拉比卡（Farag 2023）和湿处理阿拉比卡咖啡豆（Shen 2026）中检出。都没有嗅闻或定量数据，它对咖啡“肉桂”感的贡献不明。

en.name: (E)-Cinnamaldehyde
en.odor: Sweet-spicy cinnamon note, also described as apple / candy (Gantner 2024).
en.coffee: Detected by headspace GC-MS in a few studies: 0.35–0.95% of peak area in roasted Arabica and an Arabica/Robusta blend, absent from pure Robusta (Gantner 2024, flash-GC e-nose, identified by retention index); also reported in roasted Arabica (Farag 2023) and wet-processed Arabica beans (Shen 2026). There are no olfactometry or quantitative data, so its contribution to a cinnamon note in coffee is unknown.

zh.name: 对伞花烃
zh.odor: 浓度高时有典型的煤油味（Paiva 2025 所引）；也被描述为胡萝卜样（Lopes 2021 所引）。
zh.coffee: WCR 感官词典把 FlavorActiV 以对伞花烃配制的“柴油 / 机油”标准品列为“石油”味的参照之一。它收录于 Flament 的咖啡挥发物汇编（Lopes 2021 引），阿拉比卡烘焙过程中也被 GC×GC-TOFMS 检出（Paiva 2025）；但没有咖啡中的定量或嗅闻数据，是否达到可闻浓度不清楚。

en.name: p-Cymene
en.odor: Typical kerosene-like odour at high concentration (as cited by Paiva 2025); also described as carrot-like (as cited by Lopes 2021).
en.coffee: The WCR Sensory Lexicon lists FlavorActiV's 'diesel/motor fuel' standard, made with p-cymene, as a reference for Petroleum. It is in Flament's compilation of coffee volatiles (cited by Lopes 2021) and was detected by GC×GC-TOFMS during roasting of Arabica (Paiva 2025), but there are no quantitative or olfactometry data in coffee, so whether it reaches odour-active levels is unknown.

zh.name: 1,1,6-三甲基-1,2-二氢萘（TDN）
zh.cls: 降异戊二烯（类胡萝卜素降解物）
zh.odor: 汽油、煤油味——陈年雷司令葡萄酒那股“汽油味”就是它。
foods: 陈年雷司令葡萄酒（“汽油味”的来源）
zh.thr: 2 µg/L（模拟葡萄酒和中性白葡萄酒中；Sacks 2012）
zh.coffee: 只有一项研究用 GC×GC-TOFMS 在胶囊咖啡粉 / 咖啡液中初步鉴定到，属首次在咖啡中报道，未定量（Lopes 2021）；没有找到它与咖啡“石油味”相关的感官证据。

en.name: 1,1,6-Trimethyl-1,2-dihydronaphthalene (TDN)
en.odor: Petrol / kerosene – the 'petrol' note of aged Riesling.
foods: Aged Riesling wine (source of the petrol note)
en.thr: 2 µg/L in model wine and neutral white wine (Sacks 2012)
en.coffee: Putatively identified, for the first time in coffee and without quantification, in capsule-coffee powders / espresso brews by GC×GC-TOFMS (Lopes 2021); no sensory evidence linking it to a petroleum note in coffee was found.

zh.name: 2,4-二甲基噻唑
zh.odor: 在咖啡液嗅闻中被描述为咸、硫味、焦糊、橡胶味。
zh.coffee: Chin 等（2011）用 GC-O 结合全二维色谱分析咖啡液时，把它描述为“咸、硫、焦、橡胶”（据 Lopes 2021 汇总表转引）。Batali 等（2022）引用 Mahmud 等 2020 年的综述指出，它与二乙基二硫醚、苯乙烯一起与咖啡的“橡胶味”相关。没有定量和缺省实验数据。

en.name: 2,4-Dimethylthiazole
en.odor: Described in coffee-brew olfactometry as salty, sulfury, burnt, rubber.
en.coffee: Chin et al. (2011), using GC-O with comprehensive 2D GC on brewed coffee, described it as 'salty, sulfury, burnt, rubber' (via the compilation table in Lopes 2021). Batali et al. (2022), citing the review by Mahmud et al. (2020), name it together with diethyl disulfide and styrene as compounds shown to correlate with rubber flavour in coffee. No quantitative or omission data.

zh.name: 5-乙基-2-甲基噻唑
zh.odor: 在咖啡液顶空嗅闻中被描述为“橡胶样”。
zh.coffee: López-Galilea 等（2006）用顶空固相微萃取-GC-O 分析普通烘焙和 torrefacto（加糖烘焙）咖啡的滴滤与意式咖啡液，其中它被描述为“橡胶样”（据 Lopes 2021 汇总表转引）；未见其他咖啡研究的感官数据。

en.name: 5-Ethyl-2-methylthiazole
en.odor: Described as rubber-like in headspace olfactometry of coffee brew.
en.coffee: Described as 'rubber-like' by López-Galilea et al. (2006) in HS-SPME-GC-O of filter and espresso brews from conventional and torrefacto roasted coffee (via the compilation table in Lopes 2021); no other sensory data in coffee were found.

zh.name: 2-丙基吡嗪
zh.odor: 在中、深烘咖啡的嗅闻中呈令人不快的橡胶味（Obando 2024）；其他文献描述为青、蔬菜、草本，或硫味、烟熏、豆腥。
zh.coffee: Obando 和 Figueroa（2024）按 SCA 烘焙度做 GC-O，它只在中烘（RL55）和极深烘（RL25）中被闻到，强度较弱（1–2），描述为“橡胶”，含量随烘焙加深而增加。López-Galilea 2006 则描述为青、蔬菜、草本味（Lopes 2021 引）。

en.name: 2-Propylpyrazine
en.odor: An unpleasant rubber-like odour in olfactometry of medium and very dark roasts (Obando 2024); elsewhere described as green, vegetable, herbal, or sulfury, smoky, bean-like.
en.coffee: In GC-O across SCA roast levels (Obando & Figueroa 2024) it was perceived only at medium (RL55) and extremely dark (RL25) roasts, at low intensity (1–2), as 'rubber', and its concentration rose with roast degree. López-Galilea 2006 described it as green, vegetable, herbal (cited by Lopes 2021).
